# Customer Service and Support Requirements

## Executive Summary

THE customer service system SHALL serve as the central support infrastructure for the shopping mall platform, providing multi-channel customer assistance, ticket management, dispute resolution, and quality assurance capabilities. THE system SHALL integrate seamlessly with existing platform components while maintaining high service standards and customer satisfaction metrics.

WHEN customers encounter issues or require assistance, THE system SHALL provide immediate access to support services through preferred communication channels while maintaining comprehensive interaction history and resolution tracking. THE system SHALL ensure consistent service delivery across all channels and customer segments.

## Customer Support Channels

### Multi-Channel Support Infrastructure

THE platform SHALL provide integrated customer support across multiple channels including email, live chat, phone support, social media monitoring, and messaging platforms. THE system SHALL maintain unified conversation history across all channels, enabling customers to continue conversations seamlessly when switching between communication methods.

WHEN customers initiate contact, THE system SHALL identify optimal support channels based on customer type, issue complexity, current system capacity, and historical interaction preferences. THE system SHALL provide estimated response times and queue positions for each available channel to help customers make informed choices about their support experience.

THE multi-channel system SHALL implement intelligent routing capabilities that consider agent availability, skill matching, language requirements, and current workload distribution to optimize customer-agent pairings. THE system SHALL maintain real-time channel status monitoring with automatic failover capabilities to ensure continuous service availability.

WHERE high-priority customers or urgent issues are identified, THE system SHALL provide priority channel access with reduced wait times and specialized agent assignment. THE system SHALL implement VIP customer identification based on account value, purchase history, or platform contribution levels.

### Email Support Requirements

THE email support system SHALL provide structured ticket creation through dedicated support email addresses with automatic parsing, categorization, and routing capabilities. THE system SHALL implement intelligent email analysis using natural language processing to understand customer intent, urgency levels, and appropriate categorization for efficient handling.

WHEN processing email inquiries, THE system SHALL maintain complete conversation threading with automatic message association based on subject line analysis, sender identification, and content relevance scoring. THE system SHALL support rich text formatting, multiple file attachments, and embedded media handling while maintaining email response templates for common inquiry types.

THE email system SHALL provide automatic acknowledgment responses within configurable timeframes, confirming receipt and providing ticket reference numbers with clear expectations for response timing. THE system SHALL implement priority routing based on keyword detection, sender history analysis, and business rule evaluation to ensure urgent matters receive immediate attention.

WHERE email conversations require escalation or specialized handling, THE system SHALL provide seamless transfer capabilities while preserving complete interaction history and ensuring continuity of customer communication. THE system SHALL maintain audit trails of all email processing activities for quality assurance and compliance purposes.

### Live Chat Support Requirements

THE live chat system SHALL provide real-time communication with queue management, estimated wait times, and position notifications to enhance customer experience during high-demand periods. THE system SHALL implement intelligent chat routing based on agent skills, current availability, language capabilities, and customer tier classifications for optimal pairing effectiveness.

WHEN initiating chat sessions, THE system SHALL collect preliminary information through pre-chat forms including customer identification, issue categorization, urgency assessment, and preferred communication language. THE system SHALL provide contextual information to assigned agents including customer history, recent platform activity, and any relevant account details for personalized service delivery.

WHILE chat sessions are active, THE system SHALL provide real-time communication features including typing indicators, read receipts, file sharing capabilities, and co-browsing functionality when appropriate for issue resolution. THE system SHALL support chat session recording with customer consent for training, quality assurance, and dispute resolution purposes.

THE live chat system SHALL implement proactive chat capabilities allowing agents to initiate conversations with customers showing signs of confusion, extended browsing on support pages, or repeated unsuccessful self-service attempts. THE system SHALL maintain chat availability scheduling with automatic status updates based on agent login patterns and shift management.

### Phone Support Integration

THE phone support system SHALL integrate with modern telephony platforms providing call recording, intelligent routing, interactive voice response capabilities, and comprehensive call logging for customer service tracking. THE system SHALL implement voice recognition and natural language processing for automated call routing and preliminary issue identification before agent assignment.

WHEN customers request phone support, THE system SHALL provide callback scheduling options to eliminate waiting times, allowing customers to request calls at convenient times with confirmation notifications sent through preferred communication channels. THE system SHALL maintain callback queues with priority settings based on customer tier, issue urgency, and historical relationship value.

THE phone support system SHALL provide comprehensive call logging including conversation summaries, issue categorization, resolution status, and follow-up requirements for comprehensive customer interaction tracking. THE system SHALL support conference calling capabilities for complex issues requiring multiple department involvement or third-party participation.

### Social Media and Messaging Platform Support

THE social media monitoring system SHALL continuously scan major social platforms for mentions, direct messages, comments, and reviews related to the shopping mall platform, automatically converting relevant communications into support tickets for proper tracking and resolution. THE system SHALL maintain platform-specific response capabilities while ensuring consistent brand voice and accurate information across all social interactions.

THE messaging platform integration SHALL provide support across popular messaging applications including WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, WeChat, and other regionally significant platforms while maintaining conversation continuity and customer preference tracking. THE system SHALL implement message formatting adaptation for platform-specific requirements and character limitations.

WHEN social media or messaging inquiries are received, THE system SHALL provide rapid response capabilities for public-facing communications to protect brand reputation while maintaining appropriate escalation procedures for complex issues requiring detailed investigation or private information handling. THE system SHALL implement social media sentiment analysis for identifying trending issues or potential crises requiring immediate management attention.

## Ticket Management System

### Automated Ticket Creation and Classification

THE ticket creation system SHALL automatically generate support tickets from all customer inquiries across email, chat, phone, social media, and web portal channels with comprehensive metadata capture and intelligent categorization. THE system SHALL implement machine learning algorithms for issue classification based on content analysis, customer history, and resolution patterns to improve accuracy over time.

WHEN creating tickets, THE system SHALL capture essential information including customer identification, contact details, issue categorization, priority level, source channel, creation timestamp, and initial interaction content. THE system SHALL generate unique ticket identifiers following consistent formatting rules and provide customer-friendly reference numbers for easy communication and tracking.

THE ticket system SHALL support manual ticket creation by support staff for issues reported through non-automated channels, providing comprehensive templates for common scenarios and ensuring consistent information collection across all creation methods. THE system SHALL implement duplicate detection capabilities to identify and merge related tickets while preserving all associated communications and attachments.

### Priority and Categorization Framework

THE categorization system SHALL provide hierarchical classification structures with main categories, subcategories, detailed tags, and resolution type classifications to enable precise issue routing and comprehensive trend analysis. The system SHALL implement dynamic category management allowing administrators to modify classification structures based on evolving business needs and emerging issue patterns.

THE priority classification system SHALL implement four-tier priority levels (Critical, High, Medium, Low) with clear criteria definitions, response time expectations, and resolution targets specific to each category. THE system SHALL provide automatic priority suggestions based on customer tier, issue type, business impact assessment, and historical severity indicators while allowing agent override capabilities with justification requirements.

WHEN determining ticket priority, THE system SHALL consider multiple factors including customer value classification, order or transaction amounts, platform impact scope, time sensitivity, and potential business reputation implications. THE system SHALL maintain priority override controls requiring management approval for deviations from automatic suggestions while preserving audit trails for compliance and performance analysis.

### Assignment and Routing Mechanisms

THE assignment system SHALL implement intelligent routing algorithms matching customer issues with support agent skills, availability, current workload, language capabilities, and specialization areas for optimal resolution efficiency. The system SHALL maintain comprehensive agent profiles including product expertise, technical certifications, communication skills, performance history, and availability schedules to support intelligent assignment decisions.

THE routing system SHALL provide workload balancing capabilities preventing agent overload while ensuring timely response delivery across all support channels and customer segments. THE system SHALL implement automatic redistribution mechanisms when assignment imbalances are detected and provide escalation triggers when response time commitments are at risk due to capacity constraints.

WHERE specialized knowledge is required, THE system SHALL support skill-based routing to technical specialists, product experts, or management personnel with appropriate authorization levels and issue complexity matching. THE system SHALL maintain escalation pathways for complex issues requiring cross-department coordination or third-party involvement.

### State Management and Lifecycle Tracking

THE ticket lifecycle system SHALL provide comprehensive state tracking from initial creation through final resolution with detailed history maintenance for all status changes, assignments, communications, and resolution activities. The system SHALL implement standard states including New, In Progress, Pending Customer, Pending Internal, Resolved, and Closed with configurable transition rules and permission controls.

WHEN tickets change states, THE system SHALL automatically log transition details including timestamps, responsible parties, state change reasons, optional explanatory notes, and system-generated context to maintain complete audit trails. THE system SHALL provide state history visualization and reporting capabilities to support quality assurance reviews and operational analysis requirements.

THE system SHALL implement aging management with configurable time limits for each ticket state, generating automatic notifications and escalation triggers when tickets exceed defined thresholds. THE system SHALL provide aging reports and overdue alerts with management visibility and corrective action workflows to ensure no tickets are neglected during busy periods or resource constraints.

## Escalation Procedures

### Tiered Support Structure Implementation

THE escalation system SHALL implement structured support tiers with clearly defined roles, responsibilities, authorization levels, and expertise requirements appropriate for different issue complexity levels and customer types. The system SHALL define Tier 1 for general support inquiries, Tier 2 for technical issues requiring specialized knowledge, and Tier 3 for complex problems needing management intervention or cross-department coordination.

THE tiered structure SHALL provide seamless escalation pathways allowing smooth transitions between support levels while maintaining customer communication continuity and preserving complete issue context for efficient handling. THE system SHALL implement tier-specific training requirements, performance metrics, and quality standards to ensure consistent service delivery across all support levels.

WHEN escalations occur, THE system SHALL provide comprehensive handoff procedures including detailed issue summaries, attempted resolution steps, escalation justifications, customer communication history, and recommendations for next steps in the resolution process. THE system SHALL maintain escalation time tracking and success metrics to optimize tier performance and identify training opportunities.

### Automatic Escalation Mechanisms

THE automatic escalation system SHALL implement trigger-based escalation using time thresholds, priority levels, customer value classifications, and issue complexity indicators to ensure appropriate resource allocation. The system SHALL provide configurable escalation rules allowing administrators to modify triggers based on SLA requirements, business priorities, and operational capacity constraints.

THE system SHALL generate automatic notifications when escalation triggers are activated, informing appropriate supervisors, higher-tier support staff, and management personnel through preferred communication channels while providing comprehensive context and escalation justification details. THE system SHALL support escalation acknowledgment requirements ensuring escalated issues receive appropriate attention and resource allocation.

WHERE automatic escalations are prevented due to system constraints or policy restrictions, THE system SHALL provide alternative notification mechanisms ensuring management awareness of potential service issues while maintaining escalation attempt records for compliance and performance analysis purposes.

### Manual Escalation Workflows

THE manual escalation system SHALL provide intuitive interfaces enabling support agents to escalate issues requiring management attention, specialized expertise, or additional resources while requiring appropriate justification and supporting documentation. The system SHALL implement escalation approval workflows based on severity levels, business impact assessments, and customer relationship considerations to ensure proper authorization and resource allocation.

THE manual escalation interface SHALL provide template-based justification forms ensuring consistent information collection and comprehensive context documentation for efficient tier transfer and resolution continuity. THE system SHALL maintain escalation request tracking with approval status monitoring, rejection management, and alternative pathway suggestions when escalations cannot be accommodated immediately.

WHEN manual escalations are approved, THE system SHALL provide smooth handoff procedures including ticket reassignment, customer notification, status updates, and expectation management to maintain service quality during transition periods. THE system SHALL support escalation priority assessment allowing managers to evaluate and reprioritize escalated issues based on current workload and business constraints.

## Dispute Resolution

### Comprehensive Dispute Classification

THE dispute resolution system SHALL provide exhaustive categorization covering product quality disputes, delivery problems, payment disagreements, seller conduct issues, platform functionality complaints, and service-related grievances. The system SHALL implement specialized workflows for each dispute type with investigation procedures, documentation requirements, resolution timelines, and customer communication protocols specific to each category.

THE system SHALL support dispute severity assessment considering financial impact, customer relationship value, potential legal implications, and platform reputation risks to determine appropriate investigation depth and resource allocation for each case. THE system SHALL maintain dispute history tracking to identify repeat patterns and implement preventive measures for common issue types.

WHEN disputes are submitted, THE system SHALL immediately secure relevant evidence including transaction records, communication logs, product information, payment details, and delivery documentation to establish investigation baselines and prevent evidence modification or loss during dispute processing periods.

### Investigation and Evidence Management

THE investigation system SHALL provide structured evidence collection processes including document gathering, statement collection, timeline reconstruction, and third-party verification when applicable to ensure comprehensive and fair dispute resolution. The system SHALL implement evidence chain-of-custody procedures maintaining integrity and authenticity throughout the investigation process for potential legal or compliance requirements.

THE investigation workflow SHALL provide neutral fact-finding processes ensuring unbiased evaluation of all parties involved while maintaining detailed activity logs tracking every investigation step, communication attempt, and evidence review activity for transparency and accountability purposes. THE system SHALL support multimedia evidence collection including photos, videos, audio recordings, and digital documents with secure storage and access control mechanisms.

WHILE investigations are ongoing, THE system SHALL maintain regular communication with disputing parties providing status updates, timeline expectations, and process explanations while preserving confidentiality regarding sensitive information or ongoing deliberations. THE system SHALL implement investigation deadline management with automatic escalation when timelines are at risk to ensure timely resolution and customer satisfaction.

### Resolution Framework and Compensation

THE resolution system SHALL provide structured resolution options including full refunds, partial compensation, product replacements, service credits, policy exceptions, and alternative dispute resolution methods based on investigation findings and business relationship considerations. The system SHALL implement compensation approval workflows with monetary thresholds and management authorization requirements to ensure appropriate financial control while enabling timely customer satisfaction recovery.

THE resolution framework SHALL facilitate negotiation processes when parties express willingness to reach mutual agreement, providing structured offer and counteroffer mechanisms with documentation requirements and acceptance tracking for legally binding dispute settlements. THE system SHALL support resolution package creation including compensation details, policy explanations, future prevention measures, and customer education components to maximize dispute resolution value beyond immediate financial considerations.

WHERE disputes involve seller performance issues, THE system SHALL provide seller notification and improvement plan requirements including specific performance expectations, monitoring periods, training recommendations, and potential account action consequences for repeated or serious violations. THE system SHALL maintain seller dispute statistics tracking resolution rates, customer satisfaction scores, and repeat occurrence patterns to support platform quality management initiatives.

### Appeal and Review Processes

THE appeal system SHALL provide independent review mechanisms allowing dissatisfied parties to request second evaluations of dispute resolution decisions through fresh investigation processes with different personnel and expanded evidence consideration. The system SHALL implement appeal deadline management with automatic notifications and scheduling systems to ensure appeal rights are preserved while maintaining timely resolution expectations.

THE review process SHALL provide escalation pathways to senior management, legal department consultation, or third-party mediation services when initial dispute resolution and appeal processes fail to achieve satisfactory outcomes for all parties involved. THE system SHALL maintain comprehensive appeal tracking with outcome statistics, decision rationale documentation, and process improvement recommendations based on appeal patterns and results.

## Communication Templates and Automation

### Comprehensive Template Library

THE template system SHALL provide extensive response libraries covering common inquiry types including order status requests, product information questions, return and refund procedures, account assistance needs, technical support issues, and policy clarification requests. The system SHALL maintain template optimization through regular performance analysis, customer feedback integration, and issue resolution effectiveness measurement to ensure continual improvement in response quality and customer satisfaction.

THE template management system SHALL provide version control capabilities ensuring all support staff use current information reflecting latest policies, procedures, product updates, and platform changes while preventing outdated or inaccurate responses from reaching customers. THE system SHALL implement template approval workflows with subject matter expert review requirements and legal compliance verification when required for sensitive or contract-related communications.

THE system SHALL support template personalization allowing agents to customize standard responses with customer names, specific details, relevant context, and empathetic language while maintaining accuracy, professionalism, and brand voice consistency across all communications. THE system SHALL provide template usage analytics tracking selection rates, personalization frequency, and customer response quality to guide template library optimization efforts.

### Automated Notification Framework

THE notification system SHALL provide comprehensive customer communications throughout ticket lifecycles including creation confirmations, assignment notifications, status updates, resolution announcements, follow-up requests, and satisfaction surveys delivered through preferred communication channels. The system SHALL support multi-channel notifications enabling customers to receive updates via email, SMS, push notifications, in-platform messages, or voice calls based on individual preferences and communication priority levels.

THE automated notification framework SHALL provide intelligent timing controls preventing message flooding while ensuring customers receive timely updates during critical process stages, with frequency management based on communication type, customer preferences, and issue urgency indicators. THE system SHALL implement notification acknowledgment tracking with escalation procedures when critical updates remain unread or unacknowledged beyond defined timeframes.

WHERE notification delivery failures occur, THE system SHALL provide alternative communication attempts using backup channels, escalation to human agents, or direct contact methods to ensure customers remain informed about their support requests and platform account status. THE system SHALL maintain notification preference management allowing customers to modify communication channels, frequency settings, and subscription levels for different notification types.

### Multi-Language Support System

THE multi-language system SHALL provide professional translation services for all customer communications, knowledge base articles, and support documentation across supported platform languages while maintaining cultural sensitivity and regional appropriateness. The system SHALL implement native speaker review processes for complex issues, sensitive communications, or specialized terminology requiring expert knowledge beyond machine translation capabilities.

THE language support framework SHALL provide automatic language detection based on customer profile settings, geographic indicators, browser preferences, and previous interaction history to optimize communication delivery in preferred languages without requiring manual selection for each interaction. THE system SHALL support seamless language switching during conversations while maintaining complete conversation history and preventing repetition of previously communicated information.

THE system SHALL maintain language-specific knowledge bases containing localized policy information, regional regulatory requirements, cultural communication preferences, and market-specific product details to ensure accurate and appropriate support delivery across diverse customer populations. THE system SHALL provide translation quality monitoring with customer feedback integration and human review triggers when communication effectiveness metrics indicate potential translation quality issues.

## Quality Assurance and Performance Management

### Service Level Agreement Management

THE SLA management system SHALL implement comprehensive service level agreements defining specific performance targets for response times, resolution rates, customer satisfaction scores, and quality metrics applicable across all support channels, customer tiers, and issue categories. The system SHALL provide real-time SLA monitoring with threshold management, violation alerting, and performance trending to ensure consistent service delivery and proactive issue identification.

THE SLA framework SHALL provide escalation procedures when commitments are at risk including supervisor notification, resource reallocation, emergency staffing activation, and customer communication protocols to minimize impact of potential service level violations. THE system SHALL maintain SLA exemption management for planned maintenance, system outages, force majeure situations, and other exceptional circumstances with documentation requirements and customer notification procedures.

THE system SHALL support customer-specific SLA arrangements for enterprise accounts, high-value relationships, volume discount agreements, and partnership arrangements requiring specialized service levels beyond standard platform commitments. THE system SHALL provide SLA performance reporting with drill-down capabilities, trending analysis, and comparative benchmarking to support continuous improvement initiatives and contractual compliance verification.

### Performance Monitoring and Analytics

THE performance monitoring system SHALL provide comprehensive operational analytics covering response times, resolution rates, customer satisfaction metrics, agent productivity indicators, and channel-specific performance measurements across all customer service functions. The system SHALL implement customizable reporting dashboards enabling stakeholders to access relevant data while maintaining information security and appropriate access controls based on role requirements.

THE analytics framework SHALL provide predictive performance modeling using historical data, seasonal trend analysis, promotional event impact assessment, and capacity planning projections to support proactive resource management and service optimization initiatives. THE system SHALL implement performance benchmarking comparing current results against established standards, previous periods, industry best practices, and competitive intelligence to guide improvement priorities.

THE system SHALL provide real-time performance monitoring with alerting capabilities for immediate notification when performance indicators fall below acceptable thresholds or when service quality issues are detected requiring immediate management attention and corrective action. THE system SHALL support performance correlation analysis identifying relationships between different metrics, operational factors, and business events to guide strategic decision-making and investment prioritization.

### Quality Evaluation and Improvement

THE quality evaluation system SHALL implement systematic quality assessment including conversation sampling, interaction scoring, compliance auditing, and customer feedback analysis to ensure consistent service quality across all support staff and communication channels. The system SHALL provide quality scorecards with specific metrics, evaluation criteria, and improvement recommendations tailored to individual agents, teams, and organizational levels for targeted coaching and training initiatives.

THE quality monitoring framework SHALL provide real-time quality observation capabilities allowing supervisors to monitor conversations, provide coaching assistance, intervene when necessary, and capture real-time feedback for immediate improvement opportunities. THE system SHALL implement quality trend analysis identifying systemic issues, training needs, process gaps, and organizational improvement opportunities based on comprehensive quality data analysis.

THE system SHALL support continuous improvement processes through quality feedback loops, process optimization initiatives, best practice sharing, and innovation program implementation to advance service quality standards and customer satisfaction achievement. THE system SHALL provide quality improvement tracking with success measurement, benefit quantification, and return on investment analysis to support ongoing organizational commitment to service excellence.

### Customer Feedback Management

THE feedback management system SHALL provide comprehensive customer satisfaction measurement including post-resolution surveys, periodic relationship assessments, in-conversation rating systems, and detailed feedback collection mechanisms integrated into support interactions across all channels. The system SHALL implement feedback response protocols ensuring customers receive acknowledgment of their input and observe concrete improvements based on their suggestions to demonstrate organizational commitment to customer-driven service enhancement.

THE feedback analysis system SHALL provide sentiment analysis, trend identification, satisfaction driver analysis, improvement opportunity prioritization, and competitive positioning assessment based on customer input patterns and specific feedback themes. THE system SHALL support closed-loop feedback processes including direct customer communication about improvements implemented, organizational changes resulting from feedback, and ongoing engagement to strengthen customer relationships beyond individual support interactions.

THE system SHALL provide feedback integration with quality assurance processes, performance evaluation criteria, training program development, and policy modification procedures to ensure customer input directly influences service improvement initiatives and operational optimization efforts. THE system SHALL implement feedback incentive programs encouraging customer participation while maintaining unbiased feedback collection through appropriate reward structures and engagement strategies.

## Knowledge Base and Self-Service Requirements

### Comprehensive Self-Service Capabilities

THE self-service knowledge base SHALL provide exhaustive coverage of common customer questions, platform functionality guidance, policy explanations, troubleshooting procedures, and account management instructions enabling customers to find solutions independently without requiring direct support contact. The system SHALL implement intelligent search capabilities including natural language processing, keyword matching, synonym recognition, and context-aware result ranking to optimize information discovery success rates and self-service effectiveness.

THE knowledge base system SHALL provide multi-format content delivery including text articles, step-by-step tutorials, video demonstrations, interactive guides, and downloadable resources to accommodate different learning preferences and accessibility requirements across diverse customer populations. THE system SHALL implement content difficulty progression allowing customers to access basic, intermediate, and advanced information levels based on their familiarity with platform features and technical comfort levels.

THE self-service system SHALL provide personalization capabilities using customer profiles, purchase history, platform usage patterns, and previous interaction records to present relevant information proactively and customize knowledge delivery based on individual customer context and needs. THE system SHALL implement self-service success tracking with analytics identifying article effectiveness, search success rates, and escalation patterns to guide continuous improvement initiatives and content optimization efforts.

### Content Management and Maintenance

THE content management system SHALL provide comprehensive authoring tools enabling support staff, subject matter experts, and approved contributors to create, review, publish, and maintain knowledge base content with version control, approval workflows, and quality standards enforcement. The system SHALL implement content taxonomy providing hierarchical organization, cross-referencing capabilities, and intuitive navigation structures to optimize content discoverability and maintenance efficiency.

THE knowledge base maintenance system SHALL provide systematic review processes ensuring content accuracy, completeness, and currency through regular audits, user feedback integration, ownership assignments, and change management procedures applicable to all knowledge content. THE system SHALL implement content lifecycle management including creation standards, publication procedures, update notifications, and retirement processes for outdated or obsolete information to maintain knowledge base reliability and trustworthiness.

THE content system SHALL support collaborative authoring with role-based permissions, concurrent editing capabilities, comment and feedback systems, and integration with external content creation tools to maximize authoring efficiency while maintaining quality control and consistency standards. THE system SHALL provide content performance analytics identifying popular articles, search failure patterns, content gaps, and improvement opportunities to guide strategic knowledge base development and resource allocation decisions.

### Search and Discovery Optimization

THE search system SHALL provide intelligent information retrieval capabilities including automatic query suggestion, spelling correction, related topic recommendations, and advanced filtering options to enhance user experience and information discovery success rates across all customer segments. The system SHALL implement learning algorithms analyzing search patterns, click-through rates, and resolution success to continuously improve search result relevance and knowledge base organization effectiveness.

THE discovery system SHALL provide proactive information presentation based on customer behavior patterns, seasonal trends, promotional campaign requirements, and known issue patterns to present relevant knowledge content before customers encounter problems requiring support contact. THE system SHALL implement contextual help embedding within platform interfaces providing relevant educational content and common solution references optimized for specific pages, features, and user activities.

THE search optimization system SHALL provide comprehensive analytics tracking failed queries, successful searches, user satisfaction with results, and conversion rates from search to successful self-service outcomes to guide systematic improvement initiatives. THE system SHALL support search result testing with A/B comparison capabilities, alternative ranking algorithm evaluation, and user experience optimization based on empirical performance data and customer feedback integration.

THE knowledge base system SHALL integrate seamlessly with customer service operations providing agents with immediate access to relevant information during support interactions while enabling easy content contribution and feedback submission to improve knowledge resources continuously based on real-world application and customer need evolution.

## Integration Requirements

THE customer service system SHALL provide comprehensive integration with order management platforms enabling support staff to access complete customer purchase histories, current order statuses, payment information, shipment tracking details, and refund processing capabilities directly from customer service interfaces without requiring separate system navigation or authentication procedures.

THE integration framework SHALL provide real-time data synchronization ensuring all customer service interactions reflect current platform state, recent customer activities, and updated account information to prevent contradictory communications and support staff confusion during customer interactions. THE system SHALL implement integration security protocols protecting sensitive customer information while enabling efficient access for authorized support personnel across all integrated systems and functionalities.

THE system SHALL support third-party integration capabilities with customer relationship management systems, communication platforms, analytics tools, and specialized service applications while maintaining security standards, data protection requirements, and operational continuity throughout all integration activities and platform evolution initiatives.

# E-Commerce Shopping Mall Platform - Comprehensive Requirements Specification

## Executive Summary

The E-Commerce Shopping Mall platform (SM-ECO) provides a comprehensive multi-vendor marketplace solution enabling sellers to create online stores while offering customers a unified shopping experience. The platform connects buyers and sellers through an integrated ecosystem supporting product discovery, secure transactions, order fulfillment, and data-driven business intelligence.

THE platform SHALL serve as a centralized marketplace where multiple sellers can list and manage their products while customers browse, compare, and purchase from various vendors through a single interface. THE system SHALL handle complex multi-party transactions, inventory management, payment processing, and logistics coordination while maintaining security, performance, and regulatory compliance.

WHEN operating at full capacity, THE platform SHALL support thousands of concurrent sellers, process millions of monthly transactions, and provide real-time analytics for data-driven decision making across all business operations. THE system SHALL scale horizontally to accommodate business growth and seasonal traffic variations while maintaining optimal user experience.

## Core Platform Features

### Multi-Vendor Architecture
THE system SHALL support unlimited seller accounts with individual store management capabilities, allowing each seller to maintain their product catalog, pricing strategies, inventory levels, and order fulfillment processes within platform-wide standardization guidelines.

WHEN sellers join the platform, THE system SHALL provide comprehensive onboarding including store setup wizard, product listing tools, inventory management systems, order processing workflows, payment account configuration, and performance analytics dashboard for immediate business operations.

THE platform SHALL maintain strict separation between seller data and operations while enabling cross-vendor product comparisons, unified customer shopping experiences, and consolidated order management for customers purchasing from multiple sellers simultaneously.

### Unified Shopping Experience
THE system SHALL provide customers with seamless multi-vendor shopping capabilities including unified product search across all sellers, consolidated shopping carts spanning multiple vendors, combined checkout processes, and coordinated order tracking for complex multi-seller purchases.

WHILE browsing products, THE platform SHALL enable advanced filtering and sorting across all sellers including price comparisons, seller ratings, shipping options, product categories, brand selections, and customer review scores to facilitate informed purchasing decisions.

THE platform SHALL automatically calculate and display total order costs including individual seller prices, combined shipping costs, applicable taxes, promotional discounts, and platform service fees with transparent breakdown for customer clarity and trust building.

## User Actor Definitions and Permissions

### Admin Users
WHEN administrators access the platform, THE system SHALL provide comprehensive management capabilities including user account oversight, seller verification and management, platform configuration, financial reporting, system monitoring, content moderation, and dispute resolution authority across all platform operations.

THE system SHALL maintain detailed audit trails for all administrative actions including account modifications, configuration changes, content removals, financial adjustments, and dispute resolutions to ensure accountability and regulatory compliance for platform governance.

Administrators SHALL have authority to suspend or terminate seller accounts, remove inappropriate content, resolve customer-seller disputes, adjust commission structures, configure platform policies, and access all system-generated reports for platform oversight and optimization.

### Sellers/Merchants
WHEN sellers register on the platform, THE system SHALL verify business credentials, validate tax information, confirm banking details, and review product catalogs before enabling full selling capabilities to maintain platform quality standards and legal compliance requirements.

THE platform SHALL provide sellers with comprehensive store management tools including product catalog management, inventory tracking systems, order processing workflows, customer communication channels, performance analytics, promotional campaign management, and financial reporting for complete business operations.

Sellers SHALL have permissions to manage their product listings including adding new products, updating inventory levels, adjusting pricing, creating promotional campaigns, processing customer orders, managing shipping options, handling returns and refunds, and analyzing their business performance metrics.

### Customers/Buyers
THE system SHALL provide customers with full shopping capabilities including product browsing and search, shopping cart management, secure checkout processes, order tracking, customer reviews and ratings, wishlist functionality, and comprehensive account management features.

WHEN customers interact with sellers, THE platform SHALL facilitate direct communication channels for pre-sale questions, order clarifications, shipping updates, return processing, and dispute resolution while maintaining appropriate privacy protections and conversation history for reference.

Customers SHALL have access to their complete order history, saved payment methods, shipping addresses, communication preferences, wishlist items, and personalized product recommendations based on browsing and purchase patterns to enhance shopping experience and convenience.

## Authentication and Security Requirements

### Multi-Factor Authentication
THE system SHALL implement optional multi-factor authentication for all user types including SMS verification, email confirmation, authenticator app integration, and biometric authentication where supported to enhance account security and protect against unauthorized access attempts.

WHEN users enable multi-factor authentication, THE system SHALL provide backup authentication methods including recovery codes, alternative contact methods, and administrative override procedures to prevent account lockouts while maintaining security integrity.

THE platform SHALL support adaptive authentication that adjusts security requirements based on login patterns, device recognition, geographic locations, transaction amounts, and risk assessment algorithms to balance security with user experience optimization.

### Session Management
THE system SHALL implement secure session management with configurable timeout periods, concurrent session limitations, device-based session tracking, and automatic logout procedures to protect user accounts from unauthorized access and maintain system security integrity.

WHILE maintaining active sessions, THE system SHALL continuously validate user identity through token refresh mechanisms, activity monitoring, device fingerprinting, and behavioral analysis to detect potential security threats and unauthorized access attempts in real-time.

THE platform SHALL provide users with complete session visibility including active device listings, login history, location tracking, session termination capabilities, and security notifications for unusual activity to maintain transparency and user control over account access.

## Business Rules and Compliance

### Product Listing Standards
THE system SHALL enforce comprehensive product listing requirements including accurate product descriptions, clear pricing information, high-quality images, proper categorization, inventory accuracy, shipping cost transparency, and return policy compliance to maintain marketplace quality standards.

WHEN sellers create product listings, THE system SHALL validate content for compliance including prohibited item restrictions, accurate categorization, competitive pricing verification, inventory availability confirmation, and shipping feasibility assessment before publication approval.

THE platform SHALL automatically scan and flag inappropriate content including counterfeit products, prohibited items, misleading descriptions, pricing errors, low-quality images, and policy violations for administrative review and approval or rejection based on platform standards.

### Transaction Processing Rules
THE system SHALL enforce standardized transaction processing including secure payment handling, sales tax calculation, shipping coordination, order confirmation procedures, cancellation policies, and refund processing workflows that protect both customer and seller interests while maintaining platform integrity.

WHILE processing transactions, THE system SHALL implement fraud detection including payment verification, shipping address validation, order pattern analysis, behavioral assessment, and risk scoring algorithms to prevent fraudulent activities and protect platform participants from financial losses.

THE platform SHALL maintain comprehensive transaction audit trails including payment processing details, order modification history, communication records between parties, dispute resolution documentation, and regulatory compliance information for business transparency and legal protection.

## Order Management and Fulfillment

### Multi-Seller Order Processing
THE system SHALL seamlessly handle orders containing products from multiple sellers by automatically splitting orders, coordinating individual seller notifications, managing separate fulfillment processes, tracking combined shipping costs, and providing unified customer communication throughout the entire process.

WHEN customers place multi-vendor orders, THE platform SHALL optimize shipping costs by analyzing seller locations, available shipping methods, delivery timeframes, and cost structures to provide customers with consolidated shipping options and transparent cost breakdowns for approval.

THE system SHALL coordinate complex order scenarios including partial fulfillment, split shipments, varying delivery schedules, individual seller performance tracking, and consolidated customer communication to maintain high service quality and customer satisfaction despite multi-party complexity.

### Inventory Synchronization

WHILE monitoring inventory levels, THE platform SHALL automatically adjust product availability across the entire marketplace when sellers update their inventory, ensuring accurate product listings, preventing oversales, and maintaining customer trust through reliable availability information.

## Payment Processing and Financial Management

## Customer Experience and Service

### Personalized Shopping Features

WHEN customers engage with the platform, THE system SHALL track preferences including favorite categories, preferred price ranges, brand loyalties, size preferences, color choices, and shopping frequency patterns to continuously improve personalization accuracy and shopping experience relevance.

### Comprehensive Support System

THE platform SHALL implement intelligent support features including automated response suggestions, knowledge base recommendations, FAQ matching, escalation procedures, and satisfaction surveys to optimize support efficiency while maintaining personalized service quality and continuous improvement processes.

## Analytics and Business Intelligence

### Comprehensive Performance Tracking
THE system SHALL maintain detailed performance analytics across all platform operations including seller performance metrics, customer behavior analysis, transaction success rates, system performance indicators, and business intelligence reporting for data-driven decision making and continuous optimization.

WHILE tracking performance, THE platform SHALL automatically identify trends including sales seasonality, customer preference shifts, market opportunity indicators, operational efficiency metrics, and competitive positioning data to support strategic planning and tactical optimization decisions across all business areas.

THE platform SHALL provide customizable analytics dashboards for different user types including executive summaries, operational reports, seller performance views, customer insights, and system health monitoring to deliver relevant information for informed decision making at all organizational levels.

### Predictive Analytics and Insights
THE system SHALL implement advanced analytics including demand forecasting, customer lifetime value prediction, churn risk assessment, market trend analysis, and growth opportunity identification to proactively guide business strategy and operational optimization efforts for sustainable platform growth.

WHEN analyzing business data, THE platform SHALL correlate multiple data sources including transaction history, customer behavior, seasonal patterns, external market factors, and competitive intelligence to generate comprehensive insights that support strategic decision making and tactical business optimization.

THE system SHALL automatically generate proactive business recommendations including inventory optimization suggestions, pricing strategy adjustments, marketing campaign opportunities, customer retention initiatives, and operational efficiency improvements based on comprehensive data analysis and pattern recognition across all platform activities.

## System Operations and Reliability

WHILE operating at scale, THE platform SHALL automatically handle traffic spikes through elastic scaling, resource optimization, caching strategies, database optimization, and content delivery networks to maintain optimal performance during peak usage periods and promotional events without service degradation.

# Content Management Requirements

## Executive Summary

This document establishes comprehensive content management requirements for the shopping mall e-commerce platform, covering product catalog content, user-generated content moderation, media asset management, SEO optimization, and quality control workflows. The requirements ensure consistent, high-quality content across the platform while maintaining compliance standards and supporting seller success.

## Content Types and Structure

### Product Catalog Content

THE system SHALL support multiple content types for product listings. WHEN a seller creates a product, THE system SHALL require title, description, price, category, and at least one product image. THE product title SHALL be limited to 200 characters and contain meaningful product information. THE product description SHALL support rich text formatting with a minimum of 50 characters and maximum of 5,000 characters to ensure comprehensive product information.

WHILE creating product variants, THE system SHALL allow sellers to specify different SKUs, prices, inventory levels, and variant-specific images. THE variant structure SHALL support size, color, material, and custom attributes defined by sellers. WHERE products have multiple variants, THE system SHALL display clear selection interfaces for customers to choose preferred options.

### Media Asset Management

THE system SHALL support multiple image formats including JPEG, PNG, and WebP with file size limits of 10MB per image. THE system SHALL automatically generate multiple image sizes for optimal display across different devices and contexts. WHEN sellers upload product images, THE system SHALL validate image quality and reject blurry, inappropriate, or copyright-infringing content.

THE system SHALL provide image editing capabilities allowing sellers to crop, resize, and adjust brightness/contrast within the platform. THE image library SHALL support bulk upload functionality with drag-and-drop interfaces for efficient product catalog management. THE system SHALL maintain original image files while serving optimized versions to ensure fast page loading.

### Video Content Support

WHERE products benefit from video demonstrations, THE system SHALL support product video uploads up to 100MB in MP4 format. THE system SHALL automatically transcode videos for optimal streaming across different devices and connection speeds. THE video content SHALL be reviewed through the content moderation workflow before becoming publicly visible.

THE system SHALL generate video thumbnails automatically while allowing sellers to upload custom thumbnail images. THE video player SHALL support full-screen viewing, speed controls, and mobile-optimized playback for enhanced customer experience.

## Product Content Requirements

### Title and Description Standards

THE product title SHALL include brand name, product type, and key differentiating features. WHEN products are created, THE system SHALL validate titles against prohibited keywords, misleading claims, and excessive capitalization. THE description content SHALL be organized with clear sections including product features, specifications, materials, care instructions, and sizing information.

THE system SHALL provide content templates for common product categories to help sellers create consistent, comprehensive listings. WHEN sellers use templates, THE system SHALL maintain template structure while allowing customization for specific products. THE content quality score SHALL be calculated based on completeness, keyword optimization, and customer engagement metrics.

### Category-Specific Content

THE system SHALL require different content fields based on product categories. FOR electronics products, THE system SHALL require technical specifications, warranty information, and compatibility details. FOR apparel products, THE system SHALL require size charts, fabric composition, and care instructions. FOR food products, THE system SHALL require ingredients, nutritional information, and expiration date handling.

WHEN products are miscategorized, THE system SHALL suggest appropriate category changes to improve discoverability and ensure proper content requirements. THE category-specific validation SHALL prevent incomplete listings from being published while providing clear guidance to sellers about required improvements.

### SEO and Marketing Content

THE system SHALL support SEO-optimized content including meta titles, meta descriptions, and alt text for images. THE meta title SHALL be limited to 60 characters and include primary keywords. THE meta description SHALL be limited to 160 characters and provide compelling product summaries for search engine results.

THE system SHALL generate automatic SEO suggestions based on product content analysis and competitor research. WHEN sellers create content, THE system SHALL provide keyword density analysis, readability scores, and search volume data for included terms. THE SEO content SHALL be separate from customer-facing content to optimize for both human readability and search engine rankings.

## User-Generated Content Management

### Review System Requirements

THE system SHALL support product reviews with ratings, text comments, and image uploads from verified purchasers. WHEN customers submit reviews, THE system SHALL require minimum 50 characters of text content to ensure meaningful feedback. THE review ratings SHALL use a 5-star system with half-star increments for precise feedback.

THE system SHALL implement a review moderation queue where reviews are checked for inappropriate content, fake reviews, and policy violations before publication. WHEN reviews are flagged for moderation, THE system SHALL notify reviewers of status changes and provide appeal mechanisms for disputed decisions.

### Question and Answer Management

THE system SHALL support product-specific Q&A where customers can ask questions about products. WHEN questions are submitted, THE system SHALL notify sellers and previous purchasers to provide answers. THE Q&A content SHALL be searchable and help future customers with similar inquiries.

THE system SHALL validate that answers come from verified sources including product sellers, manufacturer representatives, or experienced customers. THE Q&A threads SHALL remain focused on product information while filtering out spam, off-topic content, and promotional messages.

### Community Content Guidelines

THE system SHALL establish community guidelines for all user-generated content including reviews, questions, images, and forum posts. WHEN users submit content, THE system SHALL automatically scan for prohibited content including hate speech, personal attacks, spam, and inappropriate material. THE content filtering SHALL support multiple languages and cultural contexts for international marketplaces.

THE system SHALL maintain a user reputation system based on content quality, helpfulness votes, and community contributions. WHEN users consistently create high-quality content, THE system SHALL provide enhanced visibility and reduced moderation oversight. THE reputation system SHALL help identify trusted community members for special programs and early access opportunities.

## Content Moderation

### Automated Content Screening

THE system SHALL implement automated content screening using machine learning models for text, image, and video content. WHEN content is submitted, THE system SHALL analyze for prohibited content including offensive language, violence, adult content, and intellectual property violations. THE automated screening SHALL provide confidence scores to prioritize human moderator review.

THE system SHALL maintain customizable filtering rules allowing administrators to adjust sensitivity levels based on marketplace requirements and regional regulations. THE automated screening SHALL continuously learn from moderator decisions to improve accuracy and reduce false positives.

### Human Moderation Workflow

THE system SHALL provide comprehensive moderation tools for human reviewers to examine flagged content. WHEN content requires human review, THE system SHALL present context including user history, content type, and automated screening results. THE moderation interface SHALL support bulk actions, comment addition, and escalation procedures for complex cases.

THE moderation workflow SHALL maintain detailed logs of all decisions including reviewer identity, decision rationale, and content status changes. THE system SHALL provide appeals processing where content creators can contest moderation decisions through structured review processes. THE appeal system SHALL maintain transparency while protecting moderator safety and preventing abuse.

### Seller Content Support

THE system SHALL provide content creation guidance to sellers including best practices, common mistakes, and optimization techniques. WHEN sellers upload content, THE system SHALL provide real-time feedback about potential issues including image quality, description completeness, and policy compliance. THE support system SHALL include content creation tutorials, style guides, and industry-specific recommendations.

THE system SHALL maintain a content health dashboard showing sellers their content performance, optimization opportunities, and comparison with marketplace standards. THE dashboard SHALL provide actionable insights for improving product discoverability, customer engagement, and conversion rates through better content quality.

## Content Approval Workflows

### Product Listing Approval

WHERE marketplace requires product approval, THE system SHALL implement multi-stage approval workflows including automated screening, category review, and policy compliance checks. WHEN products are submitted, THE system SHALL route them through appropriate approval queues based on product category, seller history, and risk assessment. THE approval process SHALL maintain clear timelines with escalation procedures for delays.

THE system SHALL provide approval status tracking allowing sellers to monitor their product review progress and address any issues promptly. WHERE products require modification, THE system SHALL provide specific feedback about required changes and allow resubmission through streamlined processes. THE approval workflow SHALL balance quality control with marketplace velocity to maintain competitive seller onboarding.

### Content Update Management

THE system SHALL track all content changes and implement appropriate review processes for significant modifications. WHEN sellers update product information, THE system SHALL identify critical changes including price modifications, description updates, and image replacements that may affect approval status. THE update process SHALL maintain version history allowing rollback to previous content versions when needed.

THE system SHALL implement differential review workflows where minor changes receive expedited approval while major modifications go through full review processes. THE review criteria SHALL be transparent to sellers, helping them understand what changes trigger additional review requirements.

## Quality Assurance and Compliance

### Content Standards Enforcement

THE system SHALL enforce content quality standards including image resolution requirements, description completeness, and factual accuracy. WHEN content falls below quality thresholds, THE system SHALL prevent publication and provide specific improvement guidance. THE quality standards SHALL be customizable by category and maintain consistency across the marketplace.

THE system SHALL implement plagiarism detection to identify duplicate content across product listings and external sources. WHEN potential plagiarism is detected, THE system SHALL notify both parties and provide evidence for review. THE content originality requirements shall encourage unique, descriptive content while preventing copyright violations.

### Accessibility Compliance

THE system SHALL ensure all content meets accessibility standards including alt text for images, video captions, and screen reader compatibility. WHEN videos are uploaded, THE system SHALL support caption file uploads and automatic caption generation. THE accessibility features SHALL be mandatory for marketplace compliance and support customers with disabilities.

THE system SHALL provide accessibility testing tools allowing sellers to verify their content meets ADA and WCAG guidelines. THE accessibility checker SHALL identify issues including missing alt text, poor color contrast, and inadequate keyboard navigation support. THE compliance reporting SHALL help sellers maintain inclusive shopping experiences.

### International Content Support

THE system SHALL support content localization for multiple languages, currencies, and regional preferences. WHEN products are sold internationally, THE system SHALL allow sellers to create localized versions of product content including descriptions, specifications, and sizing information. THE localization process SHALL maintain content quality across all language versions.

THE system SHALL implement cultural sensitivity checks for content appropriateness across different markets and cultural contexts. THE international content guidelines SHALL prevent inadvertent cultural offenses while maintaining authentic product representation. THE localization workflow SHALL support professional translation services and crowd-sourced translation reviews.

## Performance and Scalability Requirements

### Content Delivery Optimization

THE system SHALL optimize content delivery through CDN integration, image compression, and lazy loading techniques. WHEN customers browse product pages, THE system SHALL prioritize above-the-fold content loading while deferring secondary content. THE optimization processes SHALL maintain visual quality while minimizing load times.

THE system SHALL implement responsive content delivery serving appropriate image sizes and video quality based on device capabilities and network conditions. THE adaptive delivery SHALL enhance user experience while reducing bandwidth costs and improving page performance scores. THE performance monitoring SHALL identify optimization opportunities and track content delivery metrics.

### Storage and Backup Management

THE system SHALL implement comprehensive content storage solutions supporting various media types with automatic backup and version control. WHEN content is uploaded, THE system SHALL create multiple storage copies across different geographic regions for disaster recovery. THE backup strategy SHALL include regular integrity checks and restoration testing.

THE system SHALL maintain content lifecycle management automatically archiving old content while preserving critical business data. THE storage optimization SHALL implement intelligent caching strategies, compression techniques, and cleanup processes to manage storage costs effectively. THE retention policies SHALL comply with regulatory requirements and business continuity needs.
