page.description: Pagination page number controlling customer result set navigation. Enables administrators to browse through large customer datasets efficiently while maintaining consistent result ordering and performance optimization for administrative interfaces.

limit.description: Result limit per page for pagination control in customer listing interfaces. Balances administrative interface performance with comprehensive data access needs through configurable result set sizes optimized for efficient browsing and management workflows.

IShoppingMallCustomer.IRequest.description:
Advanced customer search and filtering parameters for administrative customer discovery and management.

This request object provides comprehensive filtering capabilities enabling administrators to locate specific customer segments based on verification status, account lifecycle, registration timelines, and engagement metrics. The flexible filtering system supports complex search combinations for sophisticated customer analysis and targeted administrative actions through proper entity references.

Administrative effectiveness is enhanced through multi-field search capabilities, temporal filtering options, and flexible sorting controls that enable efficient customer account management across large marketplace populations. The progressive enhancement approach allows basic search functionality while supporting advanced filtering requirements for specialized administrative workflows.

The request structure balances comprehensive filtering flexibility with platform performance through pagination controls and result set optimization. Administrative security is maintained through access control integration and audit trail requirements that track customer search activities for compliance and security monitoring purposes. Entity references ensure complete contextual information without additional API calls for status verification.

business_name.description: Official registered business name or company name for the seller entity. This optional field enables sellers to update their public business name while maintaining verification continuity. Business names must be between 1-255 characters to support international business registration standards and maintain marketplace display compatibility across various seller types and business entity classifications.

business_registration_number.description: Official government-issued business registration number used for tax and regulatory compliance within the marketplace platform. This optional update field allows qualified sellers to update business registration information while maintaining marketplace verification standards. The field follows the same 6-20 alphanumeric character format to accommodate various international business registration systems and maintain database consistency during seller account modifications.

tax_id_number.description: Tax identification or social security number for business taxation and financial reporting purposes. Accepts 9-12 numeric digits representing official tax identifiers. Set to null to remove tax ID for international sellers who may not have domestic tax identification or need to update to different tax systems. Maintains nullable constraint to support various international tax environments during business information modifications.

license_file_url.description: URL linking to updated or revised business license documentation files. Supports file version management for documents such as renewed business registration certificates, updated tax certificates, or industry-specific licensing changes. Maintains 500-character limit for URL consistency and system performance. Sellers use this to provide current verification documents required for marketplace compliance, account verification renewal, or additional business authority demonstrations.

verification_status.description: Updated verification status of the seller account for administrative workflow management. Standard verification lifecycle states managed through proper entity references include approval processes, rejection reasons, and suspension details. Provides complete verification context for marketplace trust rating and seller capability management without additional API lookups.

business_type.description: Updated legal business entity type classification for tax compliance and operational categorization within the marketplace platform. Defines organizational structure including business entity categories through proper entity references. Enables business restructuring to different entity types while maintaining appropriate tax classification, regulatory compliance, and documentation requirements for marketplace operations with complete contextual information.

contact_phone.description: Primary business contact phone number update utilizing international E.164 format. Supports country codes and domestic phone numbers up to 15 digits for updated contact information management. Maintains phone number format validation for customer service communications and business inquiry purposes. Nullable for privacy preference updates or international sellers who may remove phone contact options during contact preference management processes.

contact_email.description: Primary business contact email address update for marketplace communications including finance notifications, customer inquiry forwarding, platform updates, and administrative correspondence. Email address validation ensures proper format compliance and maintains 100-character limit for system integrity. Sellers use this for updating primary business contact information for operational communications throughout marketplace workflows and administrative processes.

website_url.description: Updated business website URL for brand verification and customer transparency purposes. Supports domain changes, website migrations, or brand updates within the multi-seller marketplace platform. Limited to 200 characters for international domain system compatibility while maintaining system performance and preventing link abuse within platform interfaces. Sellers use this field during business website updates, brand evolution, and customer research facilitation within marketplace environments.

store_description.description: Comprehensive business description update providing detailed overview of seller operations, product offerings, business values, and brand story evolution. Rich text format maintains 10-2000 character guidelines for effective marketing content while preventing spam or inappropriate content that could damage marketplace platform reputation. Optional updates enable sellers to maintain current business positioning, reflect product portfolio changes, communicate brand evolution, and optimize marketplace visibility through contemporary business narratives that enhance customer engagement and platform credibility.

logo_image_url.description: Updated logo or brand image URL for seller business profiles and marketplace listings. Supports revised brand representation including updated visual identity, seasonal branding changes, or improved image quality within product catalogs, seller profile pages, and storefront interfaces. Limited to 500 characters for URL storage efficiency while supporting cloud storage and CDN integration for optimal marketplace performance. Sellers implement this during brand refreshes, visual identity updates, and image optimization throughout marketplace business operations.

is_featured.description: Updated featured seller status for marketplace promotional programs. Controls premium listing placement, homepage marketing opportunities, and elevated search result visibility for participating sellers. Optional boolean flag enables administrative updates or seller maintenance of featured status based on qualifying performance metrics, promotional campaign participation, or marketplace business development opportunities that enhance brand recognition and sales conversion throughout shopping mall marketplace promotion workflows.

IShoppingMallSeller.IUpdate.description:
Seller account update DTO enabling modification of business information including contact details, verification documents, business descriptions, and operational preferences while maintaining data integrity and audit trails.

This update interface is designed for authenticated sellers to modify their account information while preserving system-managed fields and verification workflows. The optional field structure allows sellers to selectively update specific aspects of their business profile such as contact information, business descriptions, branding materials, and operational settings without affecting unchanged aspects of their account.

Security measures include authentication verification to prevent unauthorized account modifications, business validation to ensure bank account compatibility with business entities, and change tracking for audit trail management. The DTO supports seller account management workflows including profile updates, business restructuring through proper entity references, verification renewal, brand evolution, and operational preference adjustments while maintaining marketplace trust and compliance requirements.

Update operations preserve existing data through optional field support, preventing unintended overwrites while enabling precise modifications when needed. Entity references ensure complete contextual information for verification status and business type classifications without additional API calls. All updates include validation checks, business continuity verification, and compliance screening to protect marketplace integrity during business information modifications across the shopping mall platform ecosystem.

IShoppingMallPasswordChange.IUpdate.description:
Password change request for shopping mall platform supporting customer, seller, and admin password resets. Validates reset tokens while providing comprehensive security tracking for password change operations across all user account types.

This DTO establishes the complete security context for password reset operations by including user account reference, device fingerprinting, and audit trail correlation. The user reference enables clear identification of the target account while maintaining security boundaries.

The device information provides comprehensive security monitoring capabilities, replacing simple string fields with structured device fingerprinting for enhanced fraud detection and security analytics.

Audit correlation ensures password change events are properly tracked and can be linked to broader authentication workflows and security incident management.

reset_token.description: Password reset token received via email for password change authorization. Generated during password reset request and valid for single use with customizable expiration timeframe

user.description: Reference to the user account requesting password change. Provides account context and enables security validation while maintaining user privacy through summary-level information

new_password.description: New password meeting shopping mall security requirements. Must be at least 8 characters with mixed case, numbers, and special characters for strong authentication

confirm_password.description: Password confirmation field for new password verification. Must exactly match new_password field to prevent typing errors and ensure password accuracy

device.description: Comprehensive device fingerprinting information for security monitoring and fraud detection. Replaces simple user agent strings with complete device context for enhanced security analytics

audit_log_id.description: Unique identifier for audit trail correlation. Links this password change request to security logs and enables comprehensive incident tracking across the platform

security_metadata.description: Security context and validation metadata for password change operations. Contains validation results, attempt tracking, and security assessment information

validation_results.description: Array of validation check results performed during password change request processing. Includes token validation, security checks, and business rule compliance

attempt_count.description: Number of password reset attempts for this user within the current session or time window. Used for rate limiting and security monitoring

session_correlation.description: Correlation identifier linking this password change to the broader authentication session. Enables tracking of password changes within user journey contexts

device_fingerprint.description: Device fingerprint hash for security tracking and fraud detection. Enables identification of suspicious access patterns across password change attempts

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when password change request was initiated. Used for tracking reset token usage and measuring token expiration compliance

IShoppingMallPasswordConfirm.description:
Response confirming successful password change completion for shopping mall platform users. Contains success status, user account reference, and comprehensive security metadata for audit logging of password reset operations across customer, seller, and admin accounts.

This response provides complete context about the password change operation, including the affected user account for clear identification and audit trail maintenance. The security metadata enables comprehensive tracking and fraud detection capabilities.

The audit correlation ensures this password change event can be linked to the original request and broader security workflows, maintaining complete operational visibility.

success.description: Indicates whether the password change was successful. Returns true when password reset process completes without errors, false if any validation or system issues occurred

user.description: Reference to the user account that completed password change. Provides clear identification of the affected account while maintaining security through summary-level information

message.description: Human-readable confirmation message about the password change process. Provides user-friendly feedback about the completion status with appropriate security warnings and next steps

audit_log_id.description: Audit log correlation identifier linking this response to the original password change request. Ensures complete traceability across the security operation lifecycle

security_metadata.description: Comprehensive security context and validation results from password change processing. Contains detailed validation information and security assessment results

validation_results.description: Detailed validation results from password change processing. Includes security checks, business rule validations, and system integrity verifications

password_strength_score.description: Calculated password strength score indicating the security level of the new password. Higher scores indicate stronger passwords meeting complexity requirements

session_actions_taken.description: List of security actions taken during password change completion. May include session invalidation, device notifications, and security alert generation

next_security_recommendations.description: Recommended next steps for user security enhancement. Provides guidance on additional security measures and best practices following password changes

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the password change was completed. Used for audit trails, security tracking, and customer service reference across all user types

verification_code.description: Six-digit numeric verification code sent to the customer's email address during registration. Must be exactly 6 digits matching the code generated and sent via email notification system. This code expires after 15 minutes for security purposes and can only be used once. The code generation uses cryptographically secure random number generation to prevent prediction attacks.

verification_token.description: UUID-based verification token contained in email verification links. This token is generated when customers click verification links sent to their registered email address. The token must be a valid UUID v4 format and expires after 24 hours from generation. Token-based verification provides a more user-friendly experience compared to manual code entry while maintaining equivalent security characteristics.

IShoppingMallEmailVerify.description:
Email verification request for shopping mall platform supporting both code-based and token-based verification methods.

This DTO enables customers, sellers, and administrators to verify registered email addresses as part of the account registration and activation workflow. The verification process serves as a critical security checkpoint to ensure email address authenticity and prevent fraudulent account creation across all user types in the marketplace ecosystem.

The system supports two complementary verification methods to accommodate different user preferences and security requirements. Code-based verification provides explicit user control through manual entry of security codes, while token-based verification offers seamless one-click confirmation through secure email links. Both methods utilize cryptographically secure token generation with appropriate expiration periods to balance security with user experience.

Email verification integrates comprehensively with customer onboarding workflows, seller registration processes, and administrative account verification. The verification mechanism supports comprehensive audit trails for security tracking and compliance requirements while providing robust fraud prevention capabilities through rate limiting, attempt restrictions, and automated suspicious activity detection.

This verification process is mandatory for all new account registrations and serves as a prerequisite for accessing platform features. Failed verification attempts trigger appropriate security responses including temporary account suspension after excessive failures and automated review processes for potential fraud indicators.

The design accommodates various email delivery scenarios including delays, spam folder placement, and corporate email filtering while maintaining secure verification integrity throughout the validation process.

Used exclusively in email verification API operations with comprehensive error handling for expired tokens, invalid formats, previously verified addresses, and security violations including rate limiting enforcement.

success.description:
Boolean success indicator for email verification attempt outcomes. True indicates successful email verification with corresponding account activation in the marketplace platform system. False indicates verification failure due to various causes including expired tokens, invalid verification data, previously verified addresses, rate limit violations, or system authentication errors.

This field serves as the primary response status indicator for client-side logic branching and user interface state management. Success responses trigger account activation workflows, dashboard redirects, and session establishment processes. Failure responses initiate appropriate error handling flows, retry mechanisms, and user guidance systems.

The boolean nature provides simple API response parsing while maintaining comprehensive status indication across all verification scenario outcomes including edge cases and security violation responses.
success.x-prisma-description: Verification operation success status indicating email verification completion

message.description:
Comprehensive human-readable message providing detailed information about the verification result in multiple languages. This message serves dual purposes of API debugging assistance and user-facing notification text for various verification scenarios including successful verification confirmation, expired token notifications, already verified address confirmation, rate limit violation warnings, and general verification failure explanations.

Message content varies based on verification outcome, user language preferences, and specific error conditions encountered during the verification process. Successful verification messages provide positive confirmation and next-step guidance to newly activated accounts. Error condition messages explain specific failure reasons and provide actionable remediation steps such as requesting a new verification email, checking spam folders, or contacting support for persistent verification issues.

The message format supports internationalization requirements and provides appropriate context for both automated system processing and direct user display in various application interfaces including web browsers, mobile applications, and API integration environments. Message length constraints ensure appropriate display across different user interface elements while maintaining comprehensive explanatory content.
message.x-prisma-description: Detailed verification result message providing user feedback and guidance

customerId.description:
UUID identifier of the successfully verified customer account within the shopping mall marketplace platform. This field is exclusively populated for successful verification responses (success=true) and provides the unique customer reference required for subsequent API operations including profile retrieval, order management, cart operations, and personal preference modifications.

The customerId represents the primary identity key for customer entities across the entire shopping mall ecosystem including authentication systems, transaction processing, order fulfillment, customer service interactions, and administrative oversight functions. This identifier enables seamless integration with other platform features while maintaining proper account security boundaries.

For verification failure scenarios (success=false) this field remains null and should not be used for any customer-related operations. The field presence serves as an additional success confirmation mechanism alongside the boolean success flag while providing mandatory reference data for activated account workflows.
customerId.x-prisma-description: Reference to verified customer record when verification completes successfully

verifiedAt.description:
ISO 8601 formatted timestamp indicating the exact moment of email verification completion and corresponding account activation in the shopping mall platform system. This timestamp serves multiple critical functions including audit trail documentation, security event tracking, account age calculation for trust scoring, and verification expiration monitoring for various security policies.

The timestamp format follows standard ISO 8601 conventions (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ) ensuring consistent temporal data processing across different system components, time zone handling, and international customer support scenarios. This value enables comprehensive analytics including verification velocity tracking, account activation pattern analysis, and security breach timeline reconstruction when required.

The verifiedAt field provides essential chronological context for various account lifecycle operations including grace period calculations, verification timeout enforcement, and account maturity assessments used throughout the marketplace ecosystem for security and compliance purposes.
verifiedAt.x-prisma-description: Timestamp when verification was completed and customer account activated

IShoppingMallEmailVerifyResponse.description:
Email verification operation response providing comprehensive result information and account activation confirmation.

This response type encapsulates all possible outcomes of email verification attempts within the shopping mall platform authentication system. The response structure accommodates both successful verification scenarios triggering account activation workflows and verification failure conditions requiring appropriate error handling and user guidance.

Successful verification responses include complete customer identification data required for immediate platform access and feature utilization. Failure responses provide detailed failure analysis enabling appropriate remediation steps and user assistance workflows while maintaining security boundaries and preventing information disclosure that could facilitate fraudulent activities.

The response design prioritizes API consumer flexibility through comprehensive status indication while ensuring clear user communication through detailed messaging systems. Response content adapts dynamically based on verification method used, customer type (buyer, seller, administrator), verification history, and specific security policies applicable to account verification workflows across the marketplace platform.

Response messaging supports complex scenarios including token expiration handling, verification queue management, suspicious activity detection responses, and system maintenance notifications. The structure enables robust error handling across diverse client implementations including web applications, mobile platforms, and third-party system integrations while maintaining consistent user experience standards throughout the shopping mall ecosystem.

sku.description: Unique stock keeping unit identifier for this product. Must be globally unique across all sellers and products in the marketplace. Required for inventory reference and order processing.

name.description: Product name with clear, descriptive title. Should be customer-friendly and include key product characteristics for discovery and search optimization.

description.description: Comprehensive product description. Include features, benefits, specifications, and usage instructions. Well-written descriptions improve SEO and reduce customer inquiries.

price.description: Selling price of the product. Must be positive and reflect market pricing. Price will be displayed to customers in all product listings and calculations.

oneOf.description: Original price for discount display. Used to show savings when product is offered at promotional pricing. Optional - can be omitted for products without promotional pricing.

condition.description: Product condition. Valid values: new, used, refurbished. Determines customer expectations, return policies, and marketplace categorization standards.

weight.description: Product weight in kilograms. Required for accurate shipping calculations and delivery cost determination. Also affects warehouse storage and handling requirements.

weight_unit.description: Unit of measurement for product weight. Valid values: kg, g, lb, oz. Must be compatible with weight value and marketplace regional preferences.

oneOf.description: Universal product code or barcode. Enables inventory scanning, POS system integration, and automated warehouse management. Optional - can be omitted for products without barcodes.

barcode.description: Universal product code or barcode. Enables inventory scanning, POS system integration, and automated warehouse management. Optional - can be omitted for products without barcodes.

track_quantity.description: Enable inventory tracking for this product. When active, available quantity will be monitored and customers will receive stock-out notifications when inventory depletes.

allow_backorder.description: Allow orders when inventory reaches zero. Enables customers to purchase out-of-stock items with delivery once restocked. Important for customer experience during supply chain issues.

is_shipping_required.description: Enable shipping requirements for this product. Set to false for digital products, downloadable content, or services that don't require physical delivery.

is_taxable.description: Apply sales tax to this product. Determines whether jurisdiction-specific sales taxes will be calculated and added to customer purchase totals.

oneOf.description: SEO-optimized metatitle for product. Improves search engine visibility and click-through rates. Optional - system will use product name if not provided.

seo_title.description: SEO-optimized metatitle for product. Improves search engine visibility and click-through rates. Optional - system will use product name if not provided.

tags.description: Coma-separated tags for product categorization. Enhances searchability and enables targeted promotional campaigns. Use descriptive, relevant keywords.

oneOf.description: URL of primary product image. Will be displayed in search results, category listings, and product pages. Supports multiple image formats (JPG, PNG, WebP).

featured_image.description: URL of primary product image. Will be displayed in search results, category listings, and product pages. Supports multiple image formats (JPG, PNG, WebP).

Request data for creating new product listings in the shopping mall marketplace.

Requires comprehensive product information including unique SKU identification, customer-friendly description, competitive pricing, and complete product specifications. Inventory settings control stock management behavior including backorder permissions and real-time tracking capabilities.

Product variants enable configuration differences while maintaining unified marketplace presence and discovery. SEO optimization settings improve search visibility and organic traffic potential. Image galleries and tag systems enhance visual presentation and categorization effectiveness.
