IShoppingMallProductSnapshot.IRequest.description:
Search and filtering parameters for historical product snapshot retrieval operations.

Request provides comprehensive snapshot filtering including date range queries, specific field tracking, change comparison analysis, and advanced sorting options. Supports both basic date-based filtering and complex business intelligence queries for product evolution analysis.

Pagination controls enable efficient browsing of large historical datasets while optional field slicing optimizes data transfer for specific analysis requirements. Advanced options like revenue context inclusion and change field tracking provide deep insights into product performance evolution and business impact of catalog modifications.

IShoppingMallProductSnapshot.description:
Complete historical snapshot of product information for audit trail and version control purposes.

Represents the full state of a product at a specific point in time, capturing comprehensive business intelligence data including all pricing, content, configuration details, and marketplace relationships. Encapsulates the complete business context of product evolution including description updates, pricing strategy changes, category assignments, and variant availability transitions.

Snapshots enable sophisticated business analytics through temporal data trending, regulatory compliance through immutable historical records, and marketplace transparency through seller accountability tracking. Critical for tracking product performance across different versions, analyzing the impact of catalog changes on sales metrics, and maintaining regulatory audit trails for marketplace operations.

Integration points span multiple platform systems including inventory management for historical stock tracking, order processing for fulfillment analytics, category management for navigation evolution analysis, and customer review systems for social proof trending. Used extensively in seller dashboards for version comparison, administrative reporting for marketplace oversight, and business intelligence systems for competitive analysis and pricing optimization.

id.description: Unique identifier for the product snapshot. Primary key for snapshot reference and audit trail tracking.

name.description: Product name at the time of snapshot. Captures the marketing title and identification used during this specific historical period. Essential for displaying product information in historical context and maintaining consistency with historical user experiences.

description.description: Complete product description as it existed at snapshot time. Includes marketing copy, feature highlights, and detailed specifications. Preserves the complete product narrative and technical information that customers would have seen when making purchase decisions during this period.

price.description: Product base price at snapshot time. Represents the primary cost customers would pay before any discounts, promotions, or variant-specific pricing adjustments. Critical for historical price analysis and competitive tracking.

original_price.description: Original list price before any discounts or promotions at snapshot time. Enables calculation of savings amounts and promotional effectiveness analysis. Helps track pricing strategies and market positioning changes over time.

is_active.description: Product visibility and availability status at snapshot time. Indicates whether the product was purchasable and visible to customers during this period. Critical for understanding historical catalog state and inventory availability.

sku_code.description: Unique stock-keeping unit identifier used at snapshot time. Enables correlation with inventory systems and order fulfillment records. Essential for historical inventory tracking and product identification across systems.

category.description: Product category assignment at snapshot time. Represents the primary classification and navigation path customers would use to discover this product. Uses category reference with complete context for historical browsing analysis.

seller.description: Product seller/merchant information at snapshot time. Captures the business entity responsible for product listing, fulfillment, and customer service during this period. Critical for historical seller performance analysis and accountability tracking.

id.description: Unique identifier for the product variant at snapshot time. Enables precise variant tracking and correlation with historical inventory records, order fulfillment data, and customer purchase patterns. Critical for maintaining data integrity across variant-specific transactions and supporting detailed historical analysis of product performance by variant.

name.description: Variant name or option description at snapshot time. Represents the customer-facing label for different product configurations such as size, color, material, or feature sets. Preserves the exact variant presentation that customers saw when making selection decisions, enabling analysis of variant naming strategies and customer preference patterns over time.

sku_code.description: Stock-keeping unit identifier for the specific variant at snapshot time. Provides unique identification for inventory tracking, order processing, and fulfillment coordination. Essential for correlating historical sales data with inventory movements and understanding variant-specific demand patterns and stock turnover rates.

price.description: Variant-specific price at snapshot time. Captures pricing differences between product configurations such as premium materials, additional features, or size variations. Critical for historical pricing analysis, variant profitability assessment, and understanding how pricing strategies evolved across different product options and market conditions.

is_active.description: Variant availability and visibility status at snapshot time. Indicates whether customers could purchase this specific variant configuration during the historical period. Essential for analyzing variant lifecycle management, inventory availability patterns, and understanding when specific product options were introduced, discontinued, or temporarily unavailable.

variants.description: Product variant configurations available at snapshot time. Represents different product options, sizes, colors, or configurations customers could select. Maintains complete variant structure for historical product selection analysis and inventory correlation.

categories.description: All product category assignments at snapshot time. Represents the complete taxonomy and discovery paths available to customers. Multiple category assignments enable cross-category product discovery and comprehensive historical catalog organization analysis.

units.description: Product unit definitions available at snapshot time. Defines different product configurations, bundles, or purchasing options. Preserves historical product structure and enables analysis of product presentation strategies over time.

reviews_count.description: Total number of product reviews at snapshot time. Provides historical social proof metrics and customer engagement indicators. Used for historical reputation analysis and customer satisfaction trend tracking without requiring separate review API calls.

average_rating.description: Average product rating calculated from all reviews at snapshot time. Represents customer satisfaction and product quality perception during this period. Essential for historical quality analysis and comparative product performance evaluation.

created_at.description: Original product creation timestamp. Establishes the product's timeline and market entry point. Critical for product lifecycle analysis and historical market presence tracking.

updated_at.description: Last product modification timestamp before snapshot. Indicates the most recent changes made to the product information. Helps identify update patterns and modification frequency for historical audit purposes.

snapshot_created_at.description: Timestamp when this historical snapshot was captured. Establishes the specific point in time this data represents. Critical for chronological analysis and understanding when this product state existed in the marketplace.

IShoppingMallCart.IRequest.description:
Comprehensive search criteria and advanced filtering parameters for shopping cart queries across the marketplace platform.

Provides sophisticated cart discovery capabilities with support for complex multi-parameter filtering including temporal ranges, status-based selection, ownership verification, commercial analytics, and lifecycle state management. Enables advanced cart management workflows from basic customer service through comprehensive marketplace analytics.

Extends beyond simple pagination to full-featured search operations supporting abandoned cart recovery, conversion analytics, inventory reservation tracking, and multi-seller marketplace coordination. Integrates with customer authentication systems, seller analytics workflows, and comprehensive shopping cart lifecycle management across the complete e-commerce platform.

Used extensively in customer service operations, seller analytics dashboards, platform administrative monitoring, and conversion optimization workflows requiring detailed cart state analysis and historical trending capabilities.

page.description: Page number for pagination, starting from 1

order_by.description: Sorting preference for cart results. Available options include created_at_asc, created_at_desc, updated_at_asc, updated_at_desc, expires_at_asc, expires_at_desc, item_count_asc, item_count_desc

status_filter.description: Cart lifecycle status filtering options. Allows selection of specific cart states for targeted analysis including active carts, abandoned carts awaiting recovery, or completed carts for conversion tracking

from.description: Earliest cart creation timestamp for temporal filtering. Supports querying for carts created after a specific point in time

to.description: Latest cart creation timestamp for temporal filtering. Supports querying for carts created before a specific point in time

created_at_filter.description: Cart creation date range filtering for temporal cart discovery and analytics

from.description: Earliest cart modification timestamp for temporal filtering

to.description: Latest cart modification timestamp for temporal filtering

updated_at_filter.description: Cart modification date range filtering for tracking recent cart activity and customer engagement patterns

from.description: Earliest cart expiration timestamp for lifecycle filtering

to.description: Latest cart expiration timestamp for lifecycle filtering

expires_at_filter.description: Cart expiration date range filtering for cleanup analytics and abandoned cart discovery

customer_id.description: Customer ownership identifier for filtered cart analysis. Enables query of carts belonging to specific customers for individual shopping behavior analysis

from.description: Earliest last activity timestamp for engagement filtering

to.description: Latest last activity timestamp for engagement filtering

last_activity_at_filter.description: Cart activity date range filtering for customer engagement analysis and session timeout evaluation

min.description: Minimum number of cart items for quantity filtering including empty carts with 0 items

max.description: Maximum number of cart items for quantity filtering

item_count_range.description: Cart item count range filtering for analyzing cart size patterns and identifying high-value versus small shopping sessions

min.description: Minimum number of distinct products for diversity filtering

max.description: Maximum number of distinct products for diversity filtering

product_count_range.description: Product count range filtering for cart diversity analysis and customer selection complexity evaluation

IShoppingMallCartItem.IRequest.description:
Request parameters for searching and filtering shopping cart items across the multi-seller marketplace platform.

Enables comprehensive cart item discovery and analysis for customer-facing interfaces, administrative reporting, and seller analytics without exposing cart ownership relationships for security and privacy compliance.

Supports advanced querying by various cart item attributes including product information, seller relationships, pricing characteristics, and temporal patterns. Facilitates multi-dimensional analysis of customer shopping behavior, product performance, and marketplace trends while maintaining proper access controls and data segregation between sellers.

The filtering system accommodates complex marketplace scenarios including multi-seller cart compositions, cross-category shopping patterns, and promotional effectiveness tracking. All queries respect cart ownership boundaries and implement appropriate security measures for customer data protection.

search.description:
Product name or description search text utilizing full-text search capabilities. Matches against product names, descriptions, and SKU information for cart item discovery based on customer intent, product identification, or marketplace trend analysis.

Supports partial matching and relevance scoring for efficient product discovery within cart contexts. Enables quick identification of specific products across large cart inventories and facilitates customer service workflows for product-related inquiries.

product_id.description:
Filter cart items by specific product identifier to analyze product-level cart performance, inventory allocation patterns across customer sessions, and product popularity metrics within shopping cart contexts.

Enables sellers to track their product engagement within customer carts and provides marketplace administrators with comprehensive product performance analytics. Supports inventory planning and demand forecasting through cart-based product analysis.

product_variant_id.description:
Filter items by specific variant selections to understand customer preferences for particular product configurations including colors, sizes, materials, and other variant-specific options.

Provides detailed insights into variant popularity, customer configuration preferences, and variant-level inventory allocation patterns. Enables sellers to optimize their variant offerings and inventory levels based on actual customer selection patterns within shopping carts.

seller_id.description:
Filter cart items by seller identifier to view items from specific marketplace vendors for multi-seller cart analysis, seller-specific reporting, and vendor performance evaluation.

Essential for seller dashboard analytics, commission calculations, and multi-seller order fulfillment coordination. Enables sellers to monitor their product performance within customer carts while maintaining proper data segregation between marketplace vendors.

min_quantity.description:
Filter cart items by minimum quantity threshold to identify bulk purchase patterns, wholesale customer behavior, and high-volume purchase trends within the marketplace.

Enables analysis of bulk buying patterns, quantity-based discount eligibility, and inventory reservation requirements for large-quantity purchases. Supports seller inventory planning and bulk order fulfillment preparation.

max_quantity.description:
Filter cart items by maximum quantity threshold to exclude bulk purchases or focus on typical retail purchase patterns for standard customer behavior analysis.

Useful for identifying regular retail transactions, excluding wholesale or bulk purchases from standard analytics, and focusing on typical consumer shopping patterns. Supports marketplace fee calculations and standard service level analysis.

is_gift_wrapped.description:
Filter by gift wrapping selection to understand fulfillment preference patterns and service utilization across different customer segments, product categories, and seasonal trends.

Provides insights into customer service preferences, gift-oriented purchasing behavior, and special handling requirements for marketplace logistics planning. Enables analysis of premium service adoption and customer willingness to pay for additional services.

category_id.description:
Filter items by primary product category identifier to analyze category-specific cart patterns, product category performance in shopping cart contexts, and cross-category customer behavior.

Essential for category-level analytics, inventory planning by category, and understanding customer shopping patterns across different product segments. Supports marketplace category management and promotional campaign targeting.

created_after.description:
Filter items added to carts after specific timestamp to analyze new cart additions for trending products, seasonal purchase patterns, and time-based customer behavior analysis.

Supports temporal analysis of customer shopping patterns, product trend identification, and seasonal shopping behavior research. Enables comparison of cart activity across different time periods and promotional campaign effectiveness measurement.

created_before.description:
Filter items added to carts before specific timestamp for historical analysis, cart cleanup operations for expired sessions, and comparative shopping pattern analysis over time.

Useful for identifying abandoned cart patterns, analyzing historical shopping trends, and implementing cart lifecycle management policies. Supports data retention compliance and cart cleanup automation workflows.

oneOf.description: Sort results by item creation timestamp for chronological analysis of cart building patterns and customer engagement timeline tracking.
Sort results by item quantity to identify bulk purchase patterns and quantity-based customer segmentation for targeted marketing.
Sort results by individual unit price for price-sensitive analysis and customer budget preference identification.
Sort results by total line item price for transaction value analysis and high-value purchase identification.
Sort results by product name for alphabetical organization and product catalog browsing within cart contexts.
Sort results by product category name for category-based organization and cross-category shopping pattern analysis.
Sort results by seller name for vendor-based organization and multi-seller cart analysis capabilities.

sort_by.description:
Sort results by specific field to enable organized cart item presentation, pattern analysis, and customer preference identification through systematic data ordering.

Supports various analytical approaches including chronological tracking, price analysis, category-based organization, and seller-specific workflows. Each sort option provides unique insights into customer behavior and marketplace performance patterns.

oneOf.description: Ascending sort order for chronological progression, price low-to-high, or alphabetical organization depending on selected sort field.
Descending sort order for reverse chronological order, price high-to-low, or reverse alphabetical organization depending on selected sort field.

order.description:
Sort order direction with ascending or descending arrangement for cart item listings based on selected sort criteria and analytical requirements.

Enables flexible data presentation supporting various analytical needs from newest-first chronology to price-based prioritization. Essential for effective data visualization and user interface organization in cart management interfaces.

page.description:
Pagination page number for cart item result set division and navigation. Defaults to page 1 if not specified.

Enables efficient browsing of large cart inventories while maintaining optimal response performance. Supports user interface pagination controls and large dataset management for comprehensive cart analysis operations.

limit.description:
Number of items to return per page for cart item analysis and reporting. Maximum limit of 100 items to prevent response size issues while maintaining optimal API performance.

Balances comprehensive data retrieval with system performance considerations. Enables flexible page sizing based on interface requirements and data volume needs while preventing excessive resource utilization.

IShoppingMallCart.ICheckout.description:
Request DTO for converting a shopping cart into a marketplace order within the multi-seller e-commerce platform.

Coordinating complex checkout process that transforms shopping cart contents into formal marketplace orders while managing multi-seller payment processing, inventory commitment, and fulfillment coordination. Supports comprehensive checkout workflows including payment method selection, shipping preference configuration, and order customization options.

The checkout process validates cart integrity, confirms inventory availability, and coordinates payment processing across multiple sellers when necessary. Maintains cart data integrity while enabling seamless transition to order processing systems and initiating seller notification workflows for efficient marketplace operations.

Handles complex scenarios including multi-seller cart compositions, promotional code application, shipping coordination, and payment method management while ensuring proper financial reconciliation and commission calculations across all marketplace stakeholders.

paymentConfiguration.description:
Payment method selection and configuration options for order processing within the multi-seller marketplace checkout workflow.

Manages payment method selection, billing address specification, and payment credential storage preferences. Supports multiple payment types while maintaining security standards and customer convenience. Essential for coordinating complex multi-seller payment processing and commission calculations across marketplace vendors.

The payment configuration accommodates various scenarios including new payment method capture, saved payment method utilization, and billing address customization. Enables seamless integration with payment gateways while supporting marketplace-specific requirements like seller payout coordination and platform fee calculations.

paymentMethodId.description:
Identifier of the saved payment method to use for this order. If not provided, new payment method will be captured during checkout process. Enables reuse of previously stored payment credentials for streamlined customer experience.

Required when useSavedPaymentMethod is true. Links to customer's stored payment methods for quick checkout processing while maintaining security standards for payment data handling. Supports various payment method types including credit cards, digital wallets, and vendor-managed payment solutions.

useSavedPaymentMethod.description:
Whether to use a previously saved payment method for this order. Enables quick checkout processing for returning customers with stored payment credentials.

When true, requires paymentMethodId to specify which saved method to use. When false, customer will provide new payment information during checkout process. Essential for optimizing checkout conversion rates and reducing payment friction for repeat customers.

billingAddress.description:
Billing address for payment processing. May differ from shipping address if customer has separate billing and shipping addresses for business or personal organization preferences.

Provides complete billing information for payment authorization and financial record maintenance. Supports address verification systems and fraud prevention measures while accommodating customer preferences for billing location specification.

rememberPaymentMethod.description:
Whether to save this payment method for future orders. Enables convenient checkout experience for returning customers while maintaining compliance standards for payment data security.

Allows customers to store payment credentials securely for subsequent purchases, reducing checkout friction and improving conversion rates. Implements proper data retention policies and customer consent management for payment method storage.

IShoppingMallOrder.description:
Primary order entity managing multi-seller transactions and customer purchases across the marketplace platform. Coordinates complex order lifecycle from placement through fulfillment while maintaining comprehensive tracking for all stakeholders including customers, sellers, and platform administrators.

Represents complete customer purchasing transactions containing items from potentially multiple sellers, payment processing coordination, shipment tracking, and status management. Each order maintains comprehensive financial records, shipping information, and communication preferences while supporting complex fulfillment scenarios including split shipments and multi-seller coordination.

The order system manages inventory allocation, payment authorization, seller notification workflows, and customer communication throughout the entire purchase lifecycle. It integrates with inventory management systems for real-time stock updates, payment processing systems for secure transaction handling, and shipping providers for delivery tracking and customer notifications.

Orders maintain detailed audit trails for financial reconciliation, regulatory compliance, and dispute resolution while supporting various fulfillment models including direct seller shipping, platform-managed fulfillment, and third-party logistics integration. The system provides comprehensive reporting capabilities for customers, sellers, and platform administrators while ensuring proper financial accounting and commission calculations.

id.description: Primary Key. Unique identifier for this order in the shopping mall order system.

order_number.description: Order number for customer reference and communication. Generated automatically using format ORD-YYYYMMDD-NNNNNN and provides unique customer-visible order identification.

status.description: Current status of the order indicating lifecycle stage. Values: pending, confirmed, processing, shipped, delivered, cancelled, refunded and tracks order progression through fulfillment workflow.

total_amount.description: Total amount of the order including all items, shipping, and fees. Represents complete financial transaction value for customer billing and seller commission calculations.

currency.description: Currency code for the transaction following ISO 4217 standards and provides standardized monetary value representation across international marketplace operations.

shipping_address.description: Shipping address where order will be delivered to customer and provides complete delivery location specification for logistics coordination.

billing_address.description: Billing address for payment and invoice purposes and provides complete billing information for financial record maintenance and customer communications.

customer_phone.description: Customer's phone number for delivery coordination and provides contact information for shipping providers and delivery scheduling communications.

delivery_instructions.description: Additional delivery instructions or special requirements for courier. Optional field for customer-specific delivery preferences and requirements.

preferred_delivery_time.description: Preferred delivery time or scheduling requests from customer. Optional field for delivery timing and scheduling preferences and coordination.

requires_special_handling.description: Whether the order requires special handling or fragile item precautions during shipping. Controls shipping method selection and special processing requirements.

internal_notes.description: Any internal notes or flags about the order for customer service or fulfillment teams. Internal operational notes for marketplace staff and order processing coordination.

contains_multiple_sellers.description: Whether the order contains items from multiple sellers requiring coordinated fulfillment. Indicates complexity for fulfillment coordination and multi-seller order management.

payment_confirmed.description: Whether payment has been successfully completed and confirmed in system. Tracks payment status and financial authorization completion.

customer_confirmation_received.description: Customer's email confirmation that they will accept delivery or terms. Acknowledgment confirmation for order terms and delivery acceptance verification.

created_at.description: Timestamp when order was first placed by customer. Records order creation timing for chronological tracking and analytics purposes.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when order status was last updated. Records modification timing for change tracking and order lifecycle management.

cancelled_at.description: Timestamp when order was cancelled if applicable. Cancellation timing for order status tracking and cancellation analytics.

cancellation_reason.description: Cancellation reason provided by customer or system for audit purposes. Documentation for order cancellation analysis and reporting.

price_lock_expires_at.description: Price lock expiration for items in multi-step checkout process. Checkout timing control for price stability and customer purchase protection.

customer.description: Customer who placed the order. Associates order with customer account and provides customer context for marketplace operations.

customerSession.description: Session during which order was placed. Links order to customer authentication session for security tracking and audit trail maintenance.

guest.description: Guest user who placed the order. Links order to guest session for anonymous purchase tracking and session correlation.

Order line item representation mapping directly to shopping_mall_order_items database table columns without phantom fields. Contains transactional line details for individual product selections within multi-seller marketplace orders.

Provides complete order item context including product references, pricing snapshots, fulfillment tracking, and seller attribution. Maintains referential integrity across product catalog, seller profiles, and order header records through proper foreign key relationships.

Supports complex marketplace scenarios including variant-specific orders, seller-specific fulfillment workflows, and historical pricing preservation for audit compliance across distributed multi-seller transaction environments.

unit_price.description: Unit price column from shopping_mall_order_items.unit_price - stores per-item pricing at time of order for historical accuracy and commission calculations in marketplace fee processing.

discount_amount.description: Nullable discount amount from shopping_mall_order_items.discount_amount - contains promotional savings specific to individual line item or null for standard pricing in marketplace discount management systems.

oneOf.description: Null instructions indicate standard fulfillment procedures without special requirements for standard packaging, shipping, or delivery coordination within marketplace seller operations.
Custom fulfillment instructions for item-specific packing, handling, shipping preferences, or delivery requirements for specialized product categories or customer service enhancements.

fulfillment_instructions.description: Nullable fulfillment instructions from shopping_mall_order_items.fulfillment_instructions - contains seller-specific shipping preferences when applicable or null for standard marketplace fulfillment through established vendor processes and shipping protocols.

seller_confirmed.description: Seller confirmation from shopping_mall_order_items.seller_confirmed - indicates seller acknowledgment of item availability, pricing accuracy, and fulfillment capability within marketplace seller workflow confirmation systems.

oneOf.description: Null tracking number indicates non-shipped, backordered, cancelled, or in-process fulfillment stages within seller-specific order processing and marketplace order lifecycle management.
Valid carrier tracking number provided by seller after shipment departure for customer package tracking, delivery coordination, and marketplace shipment notification systems integration.

seller_tracking_number.description: Nullable seller tracking from shopping_mall_order_items.seller_tracking_number - contains valid carrier tracking identifier after seller shipment or null for pre-shipment order stages across marketplace fulfillment workflows.

Null timestamp for items awaiting seller processing in marketplace order queues before fulfillment readiness confirmation and subsequent shipping preparation stages in seller workflow systems.

seller_processed_at.description: Nullable seller processing timestamp from shopping_mall_order_items.seller_processed_at - records preparation completion time when item is ready for shipment or null for items awaiting fulfillment in marketplace seller order processing pipeline.

oneOf.description: Shipping departure timestamp when carrier accepted package from seller facility for marketplace customer delivery including carrier handoff confirmation, logistics integration, and customer notification trigger events.
Null timestamp for items in pre-shipping stages including inventory preparation, quality assurance, or within seller processing workflows before handoff to carrier for customer delivery coordination.

seller_shipped_at.description: Nullable shipping timestamp from shopping_mall_order_items.seller_shipped_at - indicates exact carrier handoff time when seller completed shipment or null for items in pre-dispatch preparation stages throughout marketplace fulfillment process.

oneOf.description: Positive price adjustment amount representing post-order pricing modifications including tax corrections, shipping fee adjustments, or final calculated totals in marketplace order completion workflows.

Null adjustment indicates original pricing maintained throughout order lifecycle without marketplace-required corrections during final processing, tax calculation, or seller price synchronization scenarios.

price_adjustment.description: Nullable price adjustment from shopping_mall_order_items.price_adjustment - contains marketplace pricing corrections or seller synchronization adjustments applied after original order or null when original pricing remains accurate throughout order completion.

gift_wrap_requested.description: Gift wrapping column from shopping_mall_order_items.gift_wrap_requested - indicates customer preference for decorative packaging and customised wrapping services when selecting gift delivery options during marketplace checkout process.

customization_notes.description: Nullable customization notes from shopping_mall_order_items.customization_notes - contains customer personalization instructions when applicable or null for standard product fulfillment without marketplace-specific product modifications or custom parameter requirements.

oneOf.description: Null backup reference indicates primary fulfillment path with no marketplace coordination, order splitting, seller handoff, or backup processing scenarios in standard single-order completion workflows.

Alternative order reference for multi-seller coordination including order splitting events, seller transfer processing, backup fulfillment scenarios, or marketplace inventory redistribution system references during complex multi-party order management.

backup_order_reference.description: Nullable backup reference from shopping_mall_order_items.backup_order_reference - contains marketplace coordination identifier for complex multi-seller order management or null for standard single-seller fulfillment without distribution or backup processing requirements.

IShoppingMallOrder.IRequest.description:
Order search criteria and pagination parameters for advanced order filtering across the marketplace platform. This DTO enables comprehensive search capabilities supporting query complexity appropriate for different marketplace actors including customers, sellers, and administrators.

The request structure supports multi-dimensional filtering including status-based filtering, date range selections, and financial criteria. Granular control enables appropriate data access for different user roles while maintaining security boundaries and performance optimization.

Search capabilities include order status progression tracking, payment confirmation validation, multi-seller identification, and comprehensive date range analysis. Pagination support enables efficient handling of large result sets common in high-volume marketplace operations.

The system ensures appropriate data access boundaries where customers access only own orders, sellers view orders containing their products, and administrators access platform-wide order data. All queries maintain security constraints while providing comprehensive search functionality across the distributed order ecosystem.

CRITICAL SECURITY: Authentication context (customerId, sellerId) is managed by JWT tokens, not request parameters. The system automatically restricts data access based on the authenticated user's role and permissions.

limit.description: Number of results per page with maximum of 100 for performance management. Query result size control for optimal performance and user experience.

IShoppingMallOrder.ISummary.description:

Utilizes order-specific database columns including primary identifier, timestamp tracking for audit purposes, and cancellation state management. Designed for efficient database queries and proper relational integrity through foreign key references.

References shopping_mall_customer via customer_id relationship while maintaining performance optimization for order listing and dashboard operations across customer, seller, and administrative interfaces.

id.description: Primary key identifier from shopping_mall_orders.id - unique system reference for order tracking and customer service operations.

customer_id.description: Foreign key reference to shopping_mall_customer.id - links the order to the purchasing customer account for buyer identification and profile referencing.

seller_id.description: Foreign key reference to shopping_mall_seller.id - identifies the selling merchant responsible for order fulfillment and business relationship management.

created_at.description: Timestamp column from shopping_mall_orders.created_at - records order creation time for chronological sorting, audit trails, and analytics reporting with UTC timezone standardization.
