IStatisticsTopProducts.IRequest.description: Request parameters for filtering and configuring top products performance analysis. Enables flexible date range selection, category filtering, seller segmentation, performance thresholds, and sorting criteria for comprehensive product ranking analysis.

IStatisticsProductCategorySales.ISummary.description:
Summary representation of product category sales statistics with aggregated performance metrics for strategic analysis and reporting.

Provides essential sales data by product category enhanced with growth indicators and comparative metrics for business intelligence purposes. Combines multiple analytics data sources to deliver comprehensive category performance assessment suitable for executive dashboards and operational oversight.

Used extensively in sales reporting, inventory planning, merchandising strategy development, and performance optimization initiatives within the shopping mall ecosystem.

category.description: Product category reference providing complete context including hierarchical position and primary metadata.

total_sales.description: Total sales revenue for the category providing financial performance measurement and strategic planning data.

total_orders.description: Total number of orders containing products from this category providing transaction volume metrics and demand indicators.

total_products_sold.description: Total quantity of individual products sold within the category providing inventory velocity measurement and stocking insights.

avg_order_value.description: Average order value for category transactions providing pricing insight and customer behavior understanding.

growth_rate.description: Period-to-period growth rate providing trend analysis and performance improvement measurement.

market_share.description: Percentage of total marketplace sales attributed to this category providing competitive position and strategic importance assessment.

date_range.description: Reporting period for category sales providing temporal context for metric interpretation and trend analysis.

id.description: Unique identifier for the product summary entry

product_name.description: Human-readable product name displayed throughout the marketplace for customer identification and catalog organization. The name serves as immediate product identification in dashboards, analytics reports, and seller performance evaluations while supporting brand recognition and product differentiation strategies across competitive marketplace segments.

product_sku.description: Stock keeping unit identifier for inventory tracking and order fulfillment coordination. The SKU enables precise variant management, inventory monitoring, and supply chain optimization while supporting operational analysis and demand forecasting for strategic business planning and marketplace inventory optimization.

category_name.description: Primary product category classification supporting marketplace navigation and customer discovery. The category enables market segmentation analysis, competitor benchmarking, and merchandising strategy development while facilitating cross-selling opportunities and customer preference analysis across related product groups and marketplace segments.

seller_business_name.description: Official business name of the selling merchant displayed for customer trust and brand recognition. The business name serves as a trust indicator in marketplace evaluations, supports seller reputation analysis, and enables competitive assessment of merchant performance while facilitating account management and strategic partnership development within the marketplace ecosystem.

total_sales_amount.description: Aggregate gross revenue generated by this product across all marketplace transactions including product sales, shipping fees, and promotional adjustments. This financial metric indicates market demand and customer acceptance while supporting pricing strategy analysis, promotional campaign evaluation, and revenue prediction modeling for strategic business planning and marketplace growth assessment.

total_quantity_sold.description: Complete unit count of successful product sales across marketplace orders indicating customer demand volume and inventory turnover velocity. The quantity metric supports supplier negotiation, manufacturing planning, and tactical pricing decisions while enabling inventory optimization and fulfillment capacity planning across multiple marketplace channels and customer segments.

average_rating.description: Customer review rating calculated on a 1.0 to 5.0 scale where 5.0 represents maximum satisfaction and 1.0 indicates significant customer dissatisfaction. The rating serves as a key performance indicator for product quality, customer satisfaction trends, and marketplace positioning while supporting competitive analysis, product development prioritization, and seller performance evaluation across multiple quality dimensions and customer feedback cycles.

review_count.description: Total number of customer reviews contributed for this product indicating market engagement and customer participation levels. The count supports statistical significance assessment for reliability evaluation, marketing strategy development, and customer feedback program effectiveness while enabling trend analysis and comparative product performance evaluation across marketplace segments and competitive positioning analysis.

margin_amount.description: Calculated profit margin per unit for comprehensive business analysis including all costs, fees, and operational expenses. The margin metric supports product line profitability assessment, competitive pricing strategy development, and operational efficiency optimization while enabling strategic decisions about product promotion, inventory investment, and marketplace focus allocation for maximum return optimization and business growth planning.

created_at.description: Timestamp indicating record creation time supporting audit trail integrity, performance measurement analysis, and historical trend evaluation. The timestamp enables comparative analysis across different time periods, supports attribution analysis for marketing campaigns and seasonal planning, and provides the foundation for time-based filtering and performance benchmarking across marketplace segments and competitive analysis scenarios.

IStatisticsTopProducts.ISummary.description:
Top performing products statistics summary providing comprehensive business intelligence metrics for marketplace analytics and strategic decision making.

This summary aggregates critical product performance indicators including sales revenue, unit volume, customer satisfaction metrics, and profitability analysis. The analytics serve as the foundation for top product rankings, performance benchmarking, merchandising optimization, and strategic product placement decisions across competitive marketplace segments.

The summary maintains comprehensive relationships linking products to their sellers, categories, and customer feedback systems while tracking financial performance, market acceptance, and profitability indicators. Data integrates transaction history, inventory movements, review systems, and cost analysis to provide complete product success measurement within competitive marketplace environments.

Used extensively in executive dashboards, seller performance programs, market trend analysis, and strategic planning initiatives to identify successful products while enabling data-driven decisions about product promotion, inventory investment, and marketplace positioning for revenue optimization and competitive advantage development.

IShoppingMallPlatformOverview.description:
Comprehensive platform overview data aggregation for administrative dashboard display.

This schema represents the unified analytics snapshot that provides marketplace administrators with complete visibility into platform performance across all operational dimensions. It consolidates critical business metrics including user acquisition, transaction volumes, revenue figures, seller performance indicators, and system health statistics into a single cohesive dashboard data structure.

The platform overview serves multiple strategic purposes including executive reporting, operational monitoring, trend analysis, and performance benchmarking. Data is aggregated from disparate sources across the marketplace ecosystem including user registration systems, transaction processing engines, inventory management platforms, and analytical monitoring tools to deliver holistic business intelligence.

Administrators rely on this comprehensive overview to make data-driven decisions about marketplace strategy, resource allocation, seller management, and platform optimization initiatives. The data structure supports both real-time monitoring needs and historical comparative analysis to identify growth patterns, performance trends, and operational improvement opportunities.

totalUsers.description: Total count of all registered users across the platform including customers, sellers, and administrators. This metric provides foundational insight into marketplace scale and user base growth trajectory while serving as a key performance indicator for platform adoption and market penetration effectiveness.

totalCustomers.description: Count of active customer accounts who have made at least one purchase or engaged meaningfully with the platform. This metric indicates marketplace viability and customer base health while serving as a foundation for retention analysis and customer lifetime value calculations.

totalSellers.description: Count of verified sellers with active storefronts and product listings on the platform. This metric reflects marketplace diversity and product availability while indicating seller confidence in platform effectiveness for reaching target customers and generating sales.

totalOrders.description: Cumulative count of all orders placed across the marketplace including completed, processing, and cancelled transactions. This metric provides insight into marketplace transaction volume and customer engagement levels while serving as a foundation for revenue analysis and operational capacity planning.

totalRevenue.description: Aggregate gross revenue across all marketplace transactions including product sales, shipping fees, and service charges before tax calculations and platform fee deductions. This represents total platform economic activity including taxable revenue, platform commission earnings, and total cash flow while serving as the primary financial performance indicator for marketplace operations and growth assessment across all active business segments and revenue channels.

averageOrderValue.description: Calculated average monetary value per order across all marketplace transactions. This metric indicates customer spending patterns and marketplace premium positioning while providing insight into pricing strategy effectiveness and customer purchasing behavior trends.

conversionRate.description: Percentage of platform visitors who complete purchase transactions indicating marketplace effectiveness in converting browsing activity into commercial outcomes. This conversion ratio reflects user experience optimization quality, product-market alignment, and overall platform commercial success rates while supporting performance benchmarking against industry standards and competitive positioning analysis within target market segments.

topSellingCategories.description: Ranked array of product categories generating highest sales volumes and revenue contributions. This data enables category-specific strategic planning and helps identify marketplace strengths and growth opportunities while supporting inventory and marketing optimization decisions.

recentOrders.description: Chronological array of recent marketplace orders providing insight into current transaction activity and customer purchasing patterns. This data supports real-time operational monitoring and helps identify emerging trends or issues requiring administrative attention.

sellerPerformance.description: Comprehensive seller ecosystem performance metrics including new registrations, active sellers, average seller ratings, and fulfillment performance indicators. This data enables seller relationship management and marketplace quality assessment while supporting seller development initiatives.

systemHealth.description: Technical infrastructure performance indicators including system availability, response times, error rates, and capacity utilization metrics. This data ensures platform reliability and supports proactive technical maintenance while maintaining optimal user experience standards.

data_refresh_timestamp.description: System timestamp indicating the last time platform overview data was refreshed from source systems. This timestamp enables administrators to understand data currency, verify system operational status, assess analytical system performance, and ensure they are working with current information for critical business decisions. Regular refresh timestamps indicate healthy system integration and reliable data synchronization across marketplace monitoring and reporting platforms.

cache_ttl_seconds.description: Cache time-to-live duration in seconds indicating how long overview data remains valid before requiring refresh from source systems. The TTL setting supports performance optimization by balancing dashboard responsiveness with data accuracy requirements while enabling administrators to understand data refresh schedules and analytical capabilities for strategic planning and operational decision making processes.

ICategoryPerformance.description:
Performance metrics for individual product categories within the marketplace platform.

This data structure captures comprehensive category-level business intelligence including sales performance, product assortment metrics, and revenue contribution analysis. Category performance tracking enables strategic merchandising decisions, inventory optimization, and marketplace positioning strategies based on data-driven insights.

Category analytics support both operational optimization and strategic planning by revealing customer preferences, seasonal trends, and market opportunities. The data enables category-specific marketing campaigns, seller recruitment targeting, and product line expansion decisions based on comprehensive performance evaluation and comparative analysis across the marketplace catalog.

categoryId.description: Unique identifier for the product category within the marketplace taxonomy system. Serves as the primary reference key for category-specific analytics and performance tracking while enabling correlation with product catalog and inventory management systems.

categoryName.description: Human-readable name for the product category providing intuitive identification for administrative reference and report generation. Represents the category label displayed in merchant tools and analytical dashboards while serving as a navigation reference for marketplace browsing experiences.

totalSales.description: Aggregate monetary value of all transactions within this category representing the complete economic contribution of this product segment to marketplace revenue. This metric indicates category commercial success and supports comparative analysis against other categories for strategic planning purposes.

totalOrders.description: Total count of marketplace orders containing products from this category providing insight into customer purchasing frequency and category popularity. This metric supports inventory planning and helps identify categories driving customer acquisition and retention within the marketplace ecosystem.

averageOrderValue.description: Calculated average monetary contribution per order for this specific category indicating customer spending patterns and category-specific purchase behavior. This metric supports pricing strategy development and helps identify categories with premium positioning potential or upselling opportunities.

growthRate.description: Percentage change in category performance over a defined time period indicating growth trajectory and market momentum. This metric supports trend analysis and helps identify emerging opportunities or declining segments requiring strategic intervention or resource reallocation.

IRecentOrder.description:
Recent marketplace order transaction snapshot for administrative monitoring and trend analysis.

This data structure captures essential order information for real-time marketplace monitoring and trend identification purposes. Recent order data provides immediate insight into marketplace activity levels and supports operational decision-making by highlighting current transaction patterns and customer engagement levels.

Administrative teams use recent order information to monitor marketplace health, identify potential issues requiring attention, and assess the effectiveness of promotional campaigns or platform changes. The data structure balances comprehensiveness with performance considerations to enable efficient dashboard loading and trend analysis capabilities.

orderId.description: Unique identifier for the recent marketplace order enabling correlation with detailed order management systems and customer service processes. Serves as the primary reference key for order-specific follow-up and resolution while supporting integration with payment processing and fulfillment systems.

orderNumber.description: Human-readable order identifier for customer reference and customer service communication. Provides meaningful order identification for administrative review and helps correlate recent activity with specific marketplace transactions and customer interactions.

customer.description: Customer summary information providing essential buyer context for administrative review and customer service identification. Includes key customer details needed for marketplace monitoring and trend analysis while maintaining performance through lightweight representation.

totalAmount.description: Monetary value of the recent order indicating transaction size and marketplace revenue contribution. This metric supports immediate assessment of marketplace performance and helps identify unusual transaction patterns or potential issues requiring administrative investigation or customer service intervention.

orderDate.description: Timestamp indicating when the recent order was placed providing chronological context for administrative review and trend analysis. Enables real-time marketplace monitoring and helps identify patterns in customer behavior and transaction timing across different marketplace segments and time periods.

status.description: Current order processing status indicating fulfillment stage and readiness for shipment or delivery. Provides standardized status representation for administrative review and helps identify orders requiring attention or intervention due to processing delays or complications.

ISellerPerformanceOverview.description:
Comprehensive seller ecosystem performance metrics and marketplace quality indicators for administrative oversight and strategic decision making.

This data structure aggregates critical seller-related business intelligence including registration trends, seller activity levels, quality ratings, compliance metrics, and marketplace contribution analysis. Seller performance overview data enables administrative oversight of seller relationship programs and supports strategic decisions about seller recruitment, development, and retention initiatives.

Seller ecosystem health is fundamental to marketplace success, and comprehensive performance tracking ensures optimal merchant experience while maintaining marketplace quality standards. The data structure provides both current state metrics and trend analysis capabilities to support proactive seller relationship management and marketplace quality enhancement programs.

seller.description: Seller summary information providing essential merchant context for administrative review and seller relationship management. Includes verification status, business identification, and account establishment details needed for performance evaluation and marketplace quality assessment while maintaining efficiency through lightweight representation. This reference enables administrative identification of specific sellers within performance analytics workflows.

newSellerRegistrations.description: Count of new seller applications and registrations processed during the specified time period indicating marketplace attractiveness for potential merchants. This metric supports seller acquisition analysis and helps evaluate the effectiveness of seller recruitment programs and marketplace positioning strategies. Registration trends reflect marketplace competitive positioning and business development success in attracting quality merchants to the platform ecosystem.

verifiedSellers.description: Count of sellers who have completed verification processes and meet marketplace business requirements for selling activities. This metric indicates qualified seller population and supports quality assessment of seller onboarding procedures and verification process effectiveness. Verified seller counts reflect marketplace quality standards and regulatory compliance while enabling administrative oversight of merchant qualification programs.

averageSellerRating.description: Composite satisfaction rating calculated from multiple quality dimensions including seller performance, order fulfillment, customer communication, and marketplace compliance. This metric reflects overall seller ecosystem quality and supports comparative analysis with marketplace quality standards and customer expectations. Rating calculations incorporate customer feedback, order success rates, and administrative quality assessments to provide comprehensive merchant performance evaluation.

sellerRetentionRate.description: Percentage of sellers maintaining active marketplace participation over defined time periods indicating seller satisfaction and platform value proposition effectiveness. This metric supports seller relationship management and helps identify factors contributing to seller loyalty and long-term marketplace commitment. Retention analysis enables proactive intervention for at-risk merchants and supports development of seller success programs that enhance marketplace stability and merchant satisfaction.

totalListingCount.description: Aggregate count of active product listings across all marketplace sellers providing insight into catalog diversity and product assortment breadth. This metric indicates marketplace content richness and supports inventory analysis alongside order processing efficiency assessment. Listing counts reflect seller engagement levels and marketplace attractiveness for customer browsing while supporting catalog management and product discovery optimization initiatives.

averageListingsPerSeller.description: Calculated average number of active product listings per seller indicating merchant engagement and marketplace utilization levels. This metric supports seller development programs and helps identify opportunities for seller catalog expansion and inventory optimization initiatives. Average listing analysis enables marketplace administrators to understand merchant behavior patterns and develop targeted support programs that enhance seller success and catalog diversity within the platform ecosystem.

ISystemHealth.description:
Technical infrastructure performance metrics and operational reliability indicators for marketplace platform systems.

This data structure monitors system performance characteristics including availability, response times, error rates, and capacity utilization to ensure optimal platform functionality and user experience quality. Infrastructure health monitoring supports proactive maintenance planning and technical issue identification while maintaining marketplace reliability standards and customer satisfaction objectives.

System health metrics enable technical operations teams to identify performance bottlenecks, plan infrastructure scaling, and ensure platform reliability for optimal commerce operations. The data structure provides both real-time monitoring capabilities and historical trend analysis to support technical planning and capacity management while maintaining service level agreements and operational excellence standards.

availabilityPercentage.description: System uptime percentage calculated against total operational time indicating platform reliability and availability for customer access. High availability percentages support customer trust and marketplace credibility while ensuring continuous commerce operations and customer satisfaction maintenance. This metric reflects infrastructure stability and supports service level agreement compliance while enabling proactive identification of system reliability issues that could impact marketplace functionality and merchant operations.

responseTimeMs.description: Average system response time measured in milliseconds for customer-facing operations indicating platform performance and user experience quality. Lower response times support optimal customer experiences and facilitate efficient marketplace browsing while supporting conversion rate optimization and customer satisfaction goals. Response time monitoring enables identification of performance bottlenecks and supports capacity planning for maintaining optimal user experiences during peak traffic periods and promotional events.

errorRate.description: Percentage of system operations resulting in error conditions indicating system stability and reliability for business-critical functions. Low error rates support marketplace reliability and help maintain customer confidence in platform functionality while enabling effective commerce operations core business requirements. Error rate analysis enables proactive issue identification and supports technical maintenance planning to minimize service disruptions and maintain optimal marketplace performance standards.

capacityUtilization.description: Percentage of available system resources currently utilized for platform operations indicating infrastructure scalability and readiness for continued growth. Appropriate utilization levels ensure system responsiveness while providing capacity for marketplace expansion and traffic increases during peak shopping periods. Capacity monitoring enables proactive scaling decisions and supports infrastructure investment planning while maintaining operational cost efficiency and performance optimization across the marketplace platform ecosystem.

IDateRange.description:
Temporal boundary specification enabling flexible date range analysis for business metrics, performance evaluation, and time-based comparative reporting.

Date range parameters enable analytical flexibility supporting different business analysis requirements including seasonal performance evaluation, comparative period analysis, and trend identification across variable time frames. The structure supports both absolute period definitions and relative time period specifications based on specific operational requirements and strategic analysis needs.

Administrative analytical workflows require precise temporal control to enable accurate performance assessment and comparative business intelligence generation across different historical periods and operational contexts. The parameter format enables standardization while maintaining flexibility for diverse analytical use cases and reporting timeline requirements.

startDate.description: Inclusive start date marking the beginning of the analysis period using ISO 8601 date format (YYYY-MM-DD). Enables boundary definition for performance evaluation and comparative analysis while supporting flexible temporal range selection for administrative planning and operational optimization activities.

endDate.description: Inclusive end date specifying the conclusion of the analysis period using ISO 8601 date format (YYYY-MM-DD). Provides temporal boundary for result set filtering while enabling comprehensive period analysis suitable for strategic planning, performance review, and comparative assessment activities across different operational contexts.

IAnalyticsSorting.description:
Advanced analytical result sorting configuration enabling comprehensive performance-based organization of business intelligence data across multiple evaluation dimensions within the shopping mall marketplace platform.

This configuration object provides sophisticated sorting capabilities that support data-driven strategic planning and operational oversight across the e-commerce marketplace ecosystem. Administrative teams leverage these parameters to prioritize analytical results based on diverse performance criteria including revenue generation, customer satisfaction metrics, operational efficiency measures, and business growth indicators throughout the multi-seller marketplace environment.

The flexible parameter structure enables targeted analysis of marketplace participant performance while supporting comparative evaluation activities essential for vendor relationship management, growth opportunity identification, and strategic resource allocation decisions. These sorting mechanisms ensure administrative staff can efficiently identify top-performing sellers, assess development opportunities, and optimize marketplace operations through comprehensive data organization and systematic performance ranking methodologies across diverse business scenarios and analytical contexts.

field.description:
Specific performance metric or data attribute to use for analytical result arrangement within the shopping mall marketplace platform. This field supports comprehensive administrative reporting and strategic business intelligence activities across multiple marketplace evaluation dimensions.

Valid sorting options span diverse business metrics including sales-based criteria (sales_volume, revenue_amount, transaction_count), operational performance measures (customer_satisfaction, order_count, fulfillment_rate), growth indicators (growth_rate, customer_base_expansion, search_ranking_improvement), and administrative tracking fields (registration_date, last_activity, account_status_changes). The field selection directly impacts analytical focus and determines which business aspects receive priority attention during administrative review processes.

Practical usage involves flexible performance evaluation where administrators might prioritize revenue-based sorting for financial planning activities, select customer satisfaction metrics for quality assurance reviews, or utilize growth-rate indicators for development opportunity identification. These sorting controls ensure administrative teams can systematically evaluate marketplace participant effectiveness while supporting comparative analysis across different business performance categories and operational success measures.
field.description_en_US: User's display name shown throughout the application

oneOf.description:
Sorting order direction controlling ascending or descending arrangement of analytical results throughout search interface implementations and data export operations. Ascending arrangement displays lower-performing or lower-valued data elements first in result sets, enabling systematic review of development opportunities and gradual performance improvement patterns across marketplace participants.

Ascending sort direction is particularly effective for identification activities where administrators need to locate sellers requiring developmental support, discover underperforming segments requiring operational attention, or systematically review gradual improvement patterns across time-based analytical sequences. This display preference supports comprehensive marketplace oversight activities while enabling targeted assistance for marketplace participants needing business development guidance and operational optimization recommendations.
oneOf.description_en_US: Ascending sort order for analytical result arrangement prioritizing lower values first

oneOf.description:
Sorting order direction controlling ascending or descending arrangement of analytical results throughout search interface implementations and data export operations. Descending arrangement displays higher-performing or higher-valued data elements first in result sets, enabling immediate identification of top marketplace performers and systematic priority review of business success indicators across administrative evaluation activities.

Descending sort direction is particularly effective for recognition activities where administrators need to identify revenue leaders, locate customer satisfaction champions, discover top-growth marketplace segments, or prioritize review of marketplace participants demonstrating exceptional business performance within the e-commerce ecosystem. This priority ordering supports strategic planning decisions while enabling rapid identification of marketplace success stories and comprehensive evaluation of top-tier vendor performance patterns across diverse operational and financial metrics.
oneOf.description_en_US: Descending sort order for analytical result arrangement prioritizing higher values first

direction.description: Sorting order direction controlling ascending or descending arrangement of analytical results where higher-performing sellers appear first (descending) or lower-performing marketplace participants receive analytical priority (ascending). This fundamental control determines data presentation ordering and influences administrative decision-making workflows through systematic result prioritization based on specific performance criteria and business significance parameters.

IPerformanceThresholds.description:
Quantitative performance filtering criteria enabling targeted analytical result specification based on specific achievement levels and operational performance standards within the shopping mall marketplace administrative ecosystem.

These threshold parameters enable sophisticated performance segmentation ensuring analytical results meet specific operational criteria while supporting strategic planning activities focused on different performance tiers, achievement levels, or marketplace quality segments. The flexible filtering criteria support both minimum performance floors and maximum performance ceilings enabling precise analytical scope definition suitable for diverse planning scenarios and operational assessment requirements across different seller populations and business performance categories.

Administrative analytical workflows require precise performance control to enable targeted analysis of specific marketplace segments while supporting comparative evaluation across different performance categories and strategic planning initiatives focused on specific marketplace quality, growth, or operational excellence objectives within the multi-vendor e-commerce environment. The parameters support comprehensive business intelligence reporting enabling administrators to efficiently analyze seller performance, identify growth opportunities, and maintain marketplace quality standards through systematic performance-based segmentation and evaluation activities across the complete seller ecosystem.

minimumRevenue.description:
Minimum revenue threshold specified in marketplace currency units for seller inclusion in administrative analytical results and performance reporting activities. This threshold filters marketplace participant population to include only merchants meeting defined revenue performance standards enabling comprehensive analysis of established market participants while supporting growth identification and top-performer recognition activities across different business scales and commercial categories.

Revenue-based filtering enables administrative teams to separate high-performing commercial entities from smaller marketplace participants, focus analytical attention on significant marketplace contributors, or identify development opportunities within specific revenue range categories. These financial boundaries ensure marketplace operators can efficiently segment merchant populations while maintaining comprehensive oversight across diverse business scale segments through systematic revenue-based performance classification and commercial effectiveness evaluation throughout the multi-seller marketplace environment essential for strategic planning and resource allocation activities.
minimumRevenue.description_en_US: Minimum revenue threshold in marketplace currency for seller inclusion filtering

maximumRevenue.description:
Maximum revenue threshold expressed in marketplace currency units for upper boundary specification in seller analytical results and administrative reporting contexts. This ceiling enables focused analysis of specific business scale segments or comparative evaluation of different seller cohorts while supporting comprehensive strategic planning activities across diverse seller population segments and varying business size categories within the e-commerce marketplace ecosystem.

Upper revenue boundaries facilitate administrative evaluation of mid-market opportunities, assessments of transition-ready sellers preparing for expansion tiers, or analysis of marketplace participants within specific commercial scale categories. These maximum revenue specifications ensure marketplace operators can systematically evaluate business growth patterns, assess progression opportunities, and maintain comprehensive revenue-distributed oversight across the complete spectrum of marketplace commercial activities while supporting strategic decision-making processes focused on business development and merchant relationship management activities throughout platform operations.
maximumRevenue.description_en_US: Maximum revenue threshold for upper boundary seller analysis

minimumOrderCount.description:
Minimum order volume threshold for marketplace seller inclusion in administrative analytical tracking and performance evaluation workflows ensuring focus on actively trading merchants rather than newly registered sellers still establishing operational presence. This operational threshold supports performance-based segmentation activities and helps identify experienced marketplace participants with established customer relationships, consistent trading patterns, and demonstrated revenue generation capabilities throughout platform operations essential for reliable performance assessment.

Order count filters ensure administrative analytical activities concentrate on marketplace vendors demonstrating genuine commercial activity while excluding inactive registrations, incomplete business setup procedures, or sellers still developing operational procedures within platform environments. These volume-based boundaries facilitate business quality assessment, operational effectiveness evaluation, and strategic relationship development within active marketplace participant communities while ensuring comprehensive reporting accuracy and meaningful business intelligence compilation across genuine retail operations within the multi-seller ecosystem critical for sound administrative planning and policy development activities.
minimumOrderCount.description_en_US: Minimum order count for active seller performance analysis

minimumRating.description:
Minimum customer satisfaction rating threshold measured on zero-to-five point scale for marketplace seller inclusion criteria ensuring administrative analytical focus on high-quality marketplace participants while maintaining consistent service standards throughout the commercial ecosystem. This quality-based filtering enables marketplace performance segmentation and supports systematic reputation-based evaluation alongside comprehensive commercial effectiveness assessment throughout administrative oversight activities within merchant relationship management workflows.

Rating-based administrative filtering ensures marketplace participants included in analytical evaluations maintain established service quality standards while supporting comprehensive vendor relationship management and marketplace oversight activities. These customer satisfaction boundaries facilitate quality-focused analysis activities, enable targeted quality improvement programs, and maintain marketplace reputation management through systematic integration of customer feedback into administrative evaluation processes while supporting strategic decision-making related to vendor relationship development and marketplace quality standard maintenance throughout complex multi-seller operational environments essential for maintaining platform reputation and customer trust.
minimumRating.description_en_US: Minimum seller rating threshold for quality-based performance filtering

IGeographicFilters.description:
Geographic location filtering parameters enabling regional seller analysis and market-specific performance evaluation across different territorial boundaries.

Geographic parameters enable market segmentation supporting regional business development initiatives, market expansion analysis, and comparative evaluation across different customer demographics and territorial market characteristics. The filtering system provides flexibility for global marketplace operations while enabling localized analysis suitable for regional strategy development and geographic market assessment requirements.

Multi-marketplace platforms require sophisticated geographic filtering to enable effective regional analysis while supporting comparative evaluation across different market territories and customer demographic segments for strategic planning and operational optimization activities.

countryCode.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code identifying specific national markets for inclusion in analytical results. Enables country-specific performance evaluation and comparative analysis across different national market environments while supporting international expansion analysis and regional business development planning initiatives across diverse geographic territories.

region.description: Administrative region or territory designation enabling sub-national market segments for detailed geographic analysis and regional business development planning. Supports province-level, state-level, or regional marketplace analysis while enabling localized business development and comparative regional performance assessment activities within larger national market contexts.

timeZone.description: IANA timezone identifier enabling time-based analytical alignment appropriate for specific geographic regions and local business activity patterns. Ensures analytical accuracy when comparing performance across different time zones while supporting appropriate temporal analysis for diverse regional market characteristics and local business operation schedules.

IShoppingMallFaqTargetAudience.description: Target audience designation for customer-facing knowledge base content. Simplified value of 'customer' for public-facing FAQ content addressing common shopper support needs.

IIconClass.description: Default icon class for knowledge base category visual styling. Standard Font Awesome icon designation providing consistent navigation enhancement and user experience consistency.

IColorClass.description: Default color class for knowledge base category theming. Standard Bootstrap color designation ensuring consistent visual appearance aligned with platform design guidelines.

IShoppingMallGlobalSearchResult.description:
Global search results aggregating information across multiple entities in the shopping mall platform.

Provides comprehensive search functionality spanning customers, sellers, products, categories, and analytics data. Enables users to discover relevant content through a unified search interface regardless of entity type.

Results are organized by entity type with appropriate context and metadata to support informed decision-making during navigation and discovery activities.

categories.description: Product categories matching the search criteria with full hierarchical context and metadata.

products.description: Product items matching the search criteria with essential product information and pricing.

sellers.description: Seller accounts matching the search criteria with business information and verification status.

customers.description: Customer accounts matching the search criteria with profile information and account status.

analytics.description: Analytics data relevant to the search including recent sales metrics and performance indicators.

total_results.description: Total count of all search results across all entity types for pagination and UI display.

search_query.description: Original search query string used to generate these results for reference and debugging.

IShoppingMallAnalyticsSummary.description:
Aggregated analytics summary providing key performance indicators and recent marketplace activity.

Presents essential business metrics in a consolidated format suitable for dashboard displays and operational oversight. Combines multiple analytics data sources to provide current snapshot views of platform performance.

Used in administrative dashboards, seller analytics interfaces, and high-level performance monitoring throughout marketplace operations.

total_revenue.description: Current total revenue across the platform providing financial performance snapshot for recent period.

total_orders.description: Current order volume providing transaction activity snapshot for operational awareness.

total_customers.description: Active customer count providing user engagement snapshot for platform growth tracking.

total_sellers.description: Active seller count providing merchant ecosystem snapshot for business relationship health.

conversion_rate.description: Overall platform conversion rate from visits to completed orders for performance assessment.

avg_order_value.description: Average order value providing transactional insight for business intelligence and pricing strategy.

date_range.description: Time period covered by analytics data providing context for metric interpretation and trend analysis.

IShoppingMallSearchAnalytics.ISummary.description:
Summary representation of shopping mall search analytics optimized for dashboard displays and high-volume analytics reporting. Provides essential search performance metrics and success indicators while including contextual customer and session information without the computational overhead of complete relationship traversal.

Contains core search engagement metrics including query text, result counts, performance ratios, and success indicators along with customer context for enhanced analytics interpretation. Enables rapid identification of search performance patterns and customer engagement trends while providing meaningful user context for dashboard analytics and search experience optimization initiatives.

return_rate.description: percentage of orders resulting in returns calculated from analytics data

click_through_rate.description: Search result click-through percentage as engagement metric

top_selling_category.description: product category with highest sales volume based on performance data

session.description: Customer session context providing search session metadata for analytics interpretation and user journey tracking

conversion_rate.description: Search conversion success rate highlighting commercial effectiveness

id.description: Unique identifier for the seller analytics summary

created_at.description: record creation timestamp for analytics snapshot

average_order_value.description: calculated average value per customer order

search_query.description: Core search query text for pattern identification and trend analysis

search_timestamp.description: Search initiation timestamp for chronological plotting and trend visualization

search_location.description: Platform location identifier for contextual analysis

search_successful.description: Binary search success indicator for dashboard status display

search_result_count.description: Total number of search results returned

results_viewed.description: Number of search results user viewed or clicked

total_revenue.description: total gross revenue across all sales in marketplace currency

device_type.description: Device category summary for multi-platform analytics

search_duration_seconds.description: Search session duration in seconds for engagement analysis

search_type.description: Search interface type categorization for dashboard filtering

customer.description: Complete customer entity reference providing user context for search analytics including customer demographics and shopping behavior patterns

seller.description: Complete seller entity reference for analytics attribution including business name and seller details

ISecurityContext.description:
Security context validation including session information and device fingerprinting.

Contains validation data to ensure the MFA setup request originates from a legitimate authenticated session and trusted device context.

This structure provides comprehensive security validation for multi-factor authentication operations, including session verification and device identification. The session ID validates the current authenticated state, device fingerprinting helps detect unusual access patterns, and IP address logging supports audit trail requirements.

session_id.description: Current authenticated session identifier for validation during MFA setup process

ip_address.description: Client IP address for security logging and session validation. Provides IP tracking for security audit trails and geographic analysis during MFA operations.

device_fingerprint.description: Device fingerprint identifier for security validation during MFA setup

href.description: Connection URL (current page URL) for session tracking and security context during MFA setup operations. Provides context about the environment where MFA setup was initiated for audit and support purposes.

referrer.description: Referrer URL (previous page URL) for session tracking and security context validation during MFA setup. Helps identify the navigation path that led to MFA setup initiation for security monitoring and user experience optimization.

IQrCodeData.description:
QR code image data as base64 encoded string for easy TOTP setup scanning.

Customers can scan this QR code with their authenticator app to automatically configure the MFA method. The image data represents a PNG format QR code containing the TOTP configuration parameters.

This field provides convenient setup integration for time-based one-time password applications, enabling customers to configure their MFA through simple QR code scanning rather than manual key entry.

items.description: Single-use backup authentication code containing 8 alphanumeric characters

IBackupCodes.description:
Array of backup authentication codes for account recovery when primary MFA method is unavailable.

Each code can be used once for emergency access, providing customers with reliable backup authentication options when their primary MFA method is inaccessible due to device loss, service interruptions, or other technical issues.

The backup codes are randomly generated during MFA setup and should be stored securely by the customer. These codes provide a critical account recovery mechanism that ensures customers can regain system access even when their primary authentication device or method is unavailable.

IStringUuidSchema.description:
UUID format validation schema for unique identifier fields across the shopping mall platform.

This schema provides consistent UUID format validation following RFC 4122 standard.
It ensures all identifier fields (user IDs, product IDs, order IDs, etc.) maintain proper UUID format.
The schema includes comprehensive format validation and clear error messaging for API consumers.

Used throughout the platform for entity identification including:
- User account IDs and authentication tokens
- Product catalog identifiers and SKU relationships
- Order management system IDs
- Payment transaction references
- Seller and admin account identifiers
- Shopping cart and session identifiers

This unified schema approach ensures type safety and prevents UUID-related validation errors
across all API endpoints while maintaining consistent format requirements.

IStringDateTimeSchema.description:
ISO 8601 date-time format validation schema for temporal data across the shopping mall platform.

This schema provides consistent date-time format validation following ISO 8601 standards.
It handles all temporal data including creation timestamps, update timestamps, order dates,
payment processing times, and audit trail timestamps throughout the e-commerce system.

The schema supports timezone-aware datetime strings and ensures consistent formatting
across all API operations. It validates proper ISO 8601 format including timezone information.

Common use cases throughout the platform:
- User registration and account creation timestamps
- Product listing creation and modification times
- Order placement and fulfillment timestamps
- Payment transaction processing times
- Review submission and moderation timestamps
- Inventory update and audit trail timestamps
- Seller activity and analytics timestamps
- Session management and authentication timestamps

This schema ensures temporal data consistency and enables reliable sorting, filtering,
and time-based analytics across the entire shopping mall API ecosystem.

content.description:
Complete textual content string supporting both plain text and HTML markup for rich content display in shopping mall platform interfaces.

This field accepts comprehensive text content including product descriptions, article content, FAQ answers, and support ticket messages. Supports HTML formatting for enhanced presentation while maintaining security through content sanitization.

Content is validated against platform security policies to prevent XSS attacks and inappropriate content. Maximum length constraints apply based on content type and usage context. For product descriptions, supports up to 5000 characters with full HTML formatting capabilities including headings, paragraphs, lists, and basic styling elements.

The content field integrates with platform SEO optimization features, supporting meta description generation and search indexing for improved marketplace discoverability.

contentType.description:
Standard MIME type specification defining the format and interpretation of the content field for proper rendering and processing across shopping mall platform components.

Supports standard MIME types including 'text/plain' for simple text content, 'text/html' for rich HTML content with formatting capabilities, and 'text/markdown' for markdown-based content processing. Each MIME type triggers specific validation rules and rendering behaviors within the platform.

Validation ensures MIME type compliance with platform-supported formats and prevents security vulnerabilities through content type verification. The field accepts IANA standard MIME type strings and maps to appropriate rendering engines for optimal user experience across web and mobile interfaces.

Content type specification enables automatic content processing workflows including HTML sanitization, markdown conversion, and text extraction for search indexing and accessibility features.

IStringContentSchema.description:
Structured content container with MIME type specification enabling rich text handling, HTML content management, and multi-format content processing throughout the shopping mall platform ecosystem.

This schema provides a standardized approach to content management across diverse platform features including product descriptions, article content, FAQ entries, support communications, and administrative documentation. The content-type-aware design enables automatic format detection, security validation, and appropriate rendering across web and mobile interfaces.

The schema integrates with platform content management workflows supporting versioning, approval processes, and multi-language localization capabilities. Content is processed through security sanitization layers to prevent XSS vulnerabilities while preserving legitimate formatting and markup for enhanced user experience.

Used extensively in product catalog management, knowledge base systems, customer support communications, and administrative content publishing throughout the marketplace platform infrastructure.

oneOf.description:
Desktop computer and laptop devices accessing the shopping mall platform through web browsers and desktop applications.

Represents traditional computing devices including Windows PCs, Mac computers, and Linux systems accessing through Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge browsers. Desktop access patterns typically involve longer session durations, higher engagement rates, and more complex navigation behaviors compared to mobile users.

Desktop analytics tracking captures full-feature usage patterns, extensive product browsing behaviors, and comprehensive marketplace interactions. This device type is crucial for B2B marketplace segments and high-value transaction analysis where detailed product comparison and research activities are common.

Platform optimization ensures desktop interfaces provide comprehensive functionality including advanced filtering, detailed product comparisons, and administrative dashboard access for sellers and platform administrators managing large product catalogs and complex business operations.

Mobile smartphone devices accessing the shopping mall platform through mobile web browsers and dedicated mobile applications.

Represents Android and iOS smartphones accessing through mobile Safari, Chrome Mobile, and platform-specific native applications. Mobile access patterns are characterized by quick browsing sessions, location-aware interactions, and social sharing behaviors integrated with device capabilities.

Mobile analytics capture location-based shopping patterns, push notification engagement rates, and mobile-specific conversion funnels. This device type dominates B2C marketplace segments with high-frequency, lower-value transactions and social commerce integrations leveraging camera, GPS, and contact capabilities.

Platform features include mobile-optimized checkout processes, QR code integration for product discovery, and mobile wallet payment integration supporting Apple Pay, Google Pay, and regional mobile payment solutions for seamless transaction completion.

Tablet devices including iPads and Android tablets accessing the shopping mall platform through optimized interfaces.

Represents touch-screen tablet devices accessing through both mobile and desktop-optimized interfaces depending on screen size and user preferences. Tablet access patterns combine mobile convenience with desktop-like engagement, often showing higher product exploration rates than mobile phones due to larger screen real estate.

Tablet analytics reveal unique user behaviors including enhanced visual product discovery, extended product image gallery interactions, and cross-device shopping journeys where users research on tablets and complete purchases on desktops or mobile devices. This device type shows strong correlation with lifestyle and entertainment purchasing behaviors.

Platform optimization includes touch-friendly interface elements, enhanced image viewing capabilities, and responsive design adaptations that leverage larger screen sizes while maintaining mobile usability patterns for intuitive navigation and product discovery experiences.

Web browser-based access across all device types providing universal platform access through standard web technologies.

Represents platform access through modern web browsers including Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge, and mobile browsers supporting HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript capabilities. Web access provides the most comprehensive feature set including advanced JavaScript interactions, real-time updates through WebSocket connections, and progressive web app capabilities.

Web analytics capture comprehensive behavioral patterns including session duration, page navigation sequences, feature utilization rates, and conversion funnel analysis across different browser types and versions. This category serves as the baseline for platform performance measurement and user experience optimization initiatives.

Platform web interfaces include responsive design implementations, progressive enhancement for varying browser capabilities, accessibility compliance for screen readers and assistive technologies, and SEO optimization ensuring marketplace content is discoverable through search engines while maintaining fast load times and optimal user experience across diverse network conditions.

Native mobile applications specifically developed for iOS and Android platforms providing optimized marketplace experiences.

Represents platform-specific mobile applications installed on smartphones and tablets through official app stores, offering enhanced performance, offline capabilities, and deep device integration including biometric authentication, camera scanning for product discovery, and push notification systems for real-time marketplace updates.

Native app analytics provide detailed usage patterns including app launch frequency, feature adoption rates, crash reporting, and performance benchmarks that enable continuous optimization of the mobile shopping experience. Native applications typically show higher user engagement, better retention rates, and improved conversion compared to mobile web experiences.

Platform native features include advanced UI/UX design following iOS Human Interface Guidelines and Android Material Design principles, biometric authentication integration using Face ID and fingerprint scanning, augmented reality product visualization, and sophisticated caching mechanisms enabling offline browsing and improved performance in low-connectivity environments.

IShoppingMallDeviceTypeEnum.description:
Comprehensive device type enumeration used for access analytics, behavioral tracking, and platform optimization within the shopping mall marketplace ecosystem.

This enumeration categorizes all platform access methods across desktop, mobile, tablet, web browser, and native application interfaces, enabling sophisticated analytics segmentation and targeted user experience optimization. The device type classification supports business intelligence reporting, conversion rate optimization, and platform performance monitoring across diverse user demographics and access patterns.

The enumeration integrates with platform analytics systems to provide detailed insights into user behavior patterns, session characteristics, and conversion funnel performance across different device categories. This supports data-driven platform development, marketing strategy optimization, and feature prioritization based on actual user engagement patterns across device types.

Used extensively throughout the shopping mall platform for analytics attribution, user session management, marketing campaign optimization, and platform development roadmap planning based on device-specific usage trends and performance metrics.

oneOf.description:
Basic search provides simple text search across product names and descriptions. Suitable for general browsing when customers know partial product information.

This search type uses keyword matching against common product fields like name, description, and basic seller information. It's optimized for speed and broad discovery, making it ideal for initial product exploration and general shopping scenarios where specific filtering isn't required.

Advanced search enables complex queries with multiple filter criteria including price ranges, ratings, seller information, and detailed product attributes.

This comprehensive search type supports faceted filtering, boolean logic, and weighted scoring for sophisticated product discovery. Customers use advanced search when they have specific requirements and need precision in their results, supporting informed purchase decisions through detailed parameter control.

Product-specific search focuses on SKU-level discovery including variant compatibility, model numbers, and detailed technical specifications.

This specialized search optimizes for technical product discovery by indexing SKU codes, technical manuals, compatibility guides, and product documentation. It enables customers to find specific products by technical identifiers when shopping for replacement parts or exact model specifications.

Category-focused search enables discovery within specific product taxonomies and hierarchical classification structures.

This navigation-oriented search helps customers explore related products within defined categories, supporting browsing behavior and categorical comparison shopping. It's designed for discovery flows where customers want to understand product families or find alternatives within specific product domains.

Seller-specific search enables discovery of seller profiles, catalog listings, and merchant-specific product information across the marketplace.

This business-focused search supports reputation-based shopping by indexing seller profiles, business information, and merchant-specific product catalogs. Customers use this when they prefer to shop from trusted sellers or need products from specific categories of merchants.

Keyword-based search performs cross-platform content discovery across products, articles, FAQ entries, and support documentation.

This unified search approach enables comprehensive platform navigation by indexing multiple content types simultaneously. It's optimized for research scenarios where customers want to explore all available information about topics, products, or services across the entire marketplace ecosystem.

Global search provides unified cross-platform discovery capabilities combining product, content, and merchant search into comprehensive results.

This integrated approach breaks down content silos to deliver holistic marketplace navigation. Customers receive aggregated results spanning products, sellers, articles, and support content, supporting complex shopping research that traverses multiple platform domains and information sources.

Faceted search provides dynamic filtering with real-time category refinement, attribute selection, and requirement-based narrowing.

This interactive search type enables progressive result refinement through multiple simultaneous filtering operations. Customers can iteratively narrow results by applying various criteria in combination, supporting discovery workflows where requirements evolve based on initial search results and available options.

Full-text search provides comprehensive content analysis with stemming, relevance scoring, and contextual understanding across all indexed marketplace content.

This advanced search employs natural language processing to understand queries in context, enabling customers to search using conversational language and receive appropriately ranked results. It supports complex research and comparison shopping through semantic understanding of search intent.

IShoppingMallSearchTypeEnum.description:
Enumeration of available search types in the shopping mall platform for different search contexts and query types.

This enum defines the various search mechanisms supported by the platform, enabling customers to discover products, content, and sellers through different approaches optimized for their specific shopping scenario and information needs.

The search types accommodate different customer behaviors from casual browsing to precision technical product discovery, supporting both simple text queries and sophisticated filtering operations. Each search type is optimized for specific use cases and incorporates business logic appropriate to the discovery context, ensuring customers can efficiently navigate the marketplace catalog regardless of their familiarity with available inventory or shopping intentions.

id.description:

This ID enables unique identification of verification status instances across the platform, supporting audit trails, status change tracking, and integration with external compliance systems requiring verifiable record identifiers.

code.description:
Business identifier code serving as a human-readable system reference for this verification status. Used in API responses, database foreign key relationships, and system integration scenarios where programmatic status identification is required.

The code enables reliable status communication across system components while maintaining flexibility for internationalization support and business vocabulary changes without impacting system integration points.

Supports localized content presentation while maintaining consistent status communication across different user contexts and platform interaction scenarios.

The name field contains the verification status in user-friendly format for profile displays, help documentation, and customer communication workflows involving account verification requirements and security status explanations.

description.description:

Contains context-specific guidance for account management decisions and policy compliance requirements across different user roles and account types.

The description field educates users and administrators about verification state implications within the shopping mall marketplace ecosystem including email verification requirements, two-factor authentication expectations, identity document submission needs, and regulatory compliance obligations governing merchant operations, payment processing eligibility, and platform access rights.

IAccountVerificationStatus.ISummary.description:

The verification statuses enable administrators and customer service teams to efficiently monitor verification states across large customer populations while supporting targeted communication for incomplete verifications. The summary format supports various stakeholder interfaces including customer profile displays, administrative oversight systems, and customer service ticketing workflows requiring verification status context for efficient account management and security monitoring across the marketplace platform.

IShoppingMallWarehouse.ISummary.description:
Lightweight summary representation of warehouse storage locations within the shopping mall platform's fulfillment network.

This optimized view is engineered for high-performance list views, inventory dashboard displays, and rapid reference scenarios across the marketplace operational interfaces. The summary provides essential warehouse identification and basic operational context while maintaining efficient data transfer and rendering performance.

The warehouse system supports multi-location inventory management, enabling sellers to distribute stock across geographical regions and optimize fulfillment operations based on customer proximity and delivery requirements. Warehouses serve as physical storage nodes in the distributed fulfillment network, coordinating with order management systems to ensure accurate inventory tracking and efficient order processing.

Warehouse locations integrate with product variant inventory levels, order shipment tracking, and seller analytics to provide comprehensive supply chain visibility. The summary representation excludes detailed operational data while maintaining critical identification and capacity information for quick reference and decision-making workflows.

id.description:
Unique identifier of the warehouse storage location using UUID v4 format.

This identifier serves as the primary key for warehouse records and is used throughout the platform for inventory tracking, order fulfillment coordination, and seller analytics. The UUID ensures global uniqueness across the distributed fulfillment network.

name.description:
Human-readable name of the warehouse facility for display and reference purposes.

The warehouse name typically includes geographical or functional identifiers to help sellers and administrators quickly identify storage locations. Examples include regional designations like 'West Coast Distribution Center' or functional descriptions like 'Electronics Fulfillment Hub'.

code.description:
Unique business identifier code for the warehouse location with global scope across the platform.

The warehouse code serves as a short, memorable identifier used in API operations, URL paths, and business workflows. Codes are typically alphanumeric and follow consistent naming conventions for easy recognition and system integration.

location.description:
Geographical location or city name where the warehouse is situated for logistical and operational reference.

The location field provides high-level geographical context for warehouse operations, typically containing city and state/province information. This helps sellers and administrators understand regional distribution patterns and optimize fulfillment strategies based on customer proximity.

oneOf.description:
Active warehouse status indicating the facility is operational and available for inventory storage and order fulfillment activities.

Active warehouses participate in the distributed fulfillment network, accept incoming inventory shipments, and can fulfill customer orders. Sellers can assign inventory to active warehouses for optimal geographical distribution and delivery performance.

Inactive warehouse status indicating the facility is temporarily or permanently unavailable for inventory operations.

Inactive warehouses are excluded from fulfillment workflows and cannot accept new inventory or process orders. Existing inventory may need to be transferred to active facilities. This status is used for maintenance periods, seasonal closures, or facility decommissioning.

status.description:
Current operational status of the warehouse facility determining availability for inventory storage and order fulfillment operations.

The status field controls warehouse participation in the fulfillment network. Active warehouses can receive inventory and fulfill orders, while inactive warehouses are excluded from operational workflows. Status changes are managed through administrative interfaces with proper audit trails.

total_capacity.description:
Total storage capacity of the warehouse in standardized units or volume measurements.

Capacity measurements represent the maximum inventory storage capability of the warehouse facility. Units are consistent across the platform and may represent physical space (square footage), storage positions (pallet locations), or volume-based measurements depending on the product categories supported.

available_capacity.description:
Currently available storage capacity in the warehouse for new inventory allocation.

Available capacity represents the remaining storage space after accounting for current inventory levels. This metric is dynamically updated based on inventory movements and serves as a key input for inventory allocation decisions, new seller onboarding, and capacity planning workflows.
